economy.zh:
昨日全球市场在AI叙事分化与政策博弈中寻找方向。美股方面，苹果起诉OpenAI窃取商业秘密，凸显科技巨头间合作与竞争的白热化；而SK海力士纳斯达克首日大涨13%，Circle获银行牌照，显示资金仍在追捧硬科技与合规性资产。中国经济层面，Shein获证监会批准赴港IPO，估值或达500亿美元，成为年内最大中概股上市事件；科创板七周年，科技企业融资引擎持续发力。欧洲经济则面临德企破产潮与西班牙试探共同债务提案的双重压力。同花顺社区情绪偏向题材炒作，军工、半导体获资金突击，而招商证券浮盈百亿引发长期增长拷问。

- **AI裂变**：苹果起诉OpenAI（[Apple sues OpenAI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/apple-openai-lawsuit-trade-secrets.html)）与OpenAI内部权力集中至Brockman（[OpenAI power consolidates](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/openai-power-consolidates-under-co-founder-greg-brockman-ahead-of-ipo.html)），反映AI商业模式从合作走向控制。同时，AI竞赛转向低成本高效系统（[AI race shifting](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/the-ai-race-is-shifting-from-bigger-models-to-cheaper-smarter-systems.html)），对芯片需求结构产生影响。
- **政策与监管**：特朗普放松对阿联酋出口管制（[Trump admin eases export controls](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/trump-uae-mgx-crypto-export-commerce-warren.html)），被沃伦抨击为“腐败条款”；Circle获OCC银行牌照（[Circle gets bank charter](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/circle-gets-an-occ-bank-charter-as-stablecoin-competition-heats-up-shares-surge-14percent.html)），稳定币合规化加速；特朗普拒签住房法案（[Trump says he won't sign housing bill](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/trump-housing-bill-save-act-law.html)），将自动生效，影响房地产板块。
- **IPO与市场**：SK海力士纳斯达克上市（[SK Hynix rises 13%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-skhy-stock-nasdaq.html)），董事长称“需求巨大”；Shein获批港交所上市（[Shein receives approval](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3360165/shein-receives-approval-hong-kong-ipo-chinese-regulators)），为第三度冲刺；晶合集成实现A+H（[晶合集成港股首日](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE43d2NaZVVZRVE0akRINVcwRWFReUk3dnB0V2ZHR1VBSUk1b2hZdnVwRGEtNWJLX0xtVTI1Z1AyYU9oakRfLW9ZM2llZklxWkExNUtmTA)），但先进制程稀缺性存疑。
- **欧洲压力**：德国企业破产潮（[Bankruptcy boom](https://news.google.)）蔓延，能源成本与需求疲软；西班牙提出共同债务（[Spain Broaches EU Taboo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPRDFpRl9TQmx3VlY0UUJUdTFwcVFiWmhya1V4Sk9nc0h2X0d6T18zcTJXZGFaUHd6Q2hkZlZwYVoxVkphVnk0OEhnVEZ1V0tjdEE0U3lBY1V4NVBRTnN1eUJrWUtraVNzU3V4Rjlyd2JGbG4wYjByVl9nclpoNHpPNnQzUDFqT19MN1ZF)），试探欧盟财政一体化底线。
- **社区题材**：军工8股涨停（[军工装备8股爆了](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE83em1qVlFkUU9rTWxqMEVMdXZmODFMdmpTYUNUXzlwMUp3MHJyODh4RUFzOWRLRjlPNHFhdmlGZmJIYXRjdjFSQXdZYkpDZTlpZC15WlB3cUEtWVAxcjdPc2x3)）、拟收购半导体公司5倍牛股复牌（[拟收购半导体公司](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBvTjJGTlJVb2J5YnVnSFFvMmN4NHBxeWxtU3ZqRHJvSVNKUDBIWkNjbXo2YnZxalNybTIwVkJBU3o5MmZzenRISEJqeDdyZHlMc3BFMGM0dDJzbldJbWlvVFF3)），显示散户对政策利好的敏感反应，但需警惕基本面风险（如000980连续亏损被立案[000980被立案](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1OWnNXTXB6bkxJcnFnT0lmMzVoaGxmWjh5LUk5eF9kUjVoMUpaXzhoQkVhNFFzN0g0NUdXYk1tODlIU2ZPZy1zVV9IVTY0TWhZTUhyTFBZaGdXYVVVYU8wanN3)）。

**后续观察**：AI产业链内部诉讼可能重塑合作格局，关注苹果-OpenAI关系破裂对iPhone集成ChatGPT的影响；Shein香港IPO定价及超额认购情况将反映海外对中国消费科技的态度；欧洲破产潮若持续，或倒逼欧央行更激进宽松。
economy.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a deepening legal and regulatory battle in AI, a landmark crypto bank charter in the US, and a major breakthrough for Chinese fast-fashion firm Shein's long-awaited IPO. US markets rose on continued appetite for AI winners, while European markets grappled with oil-supply risks and rising corporate insolvencies. Chinese tech stocks got a boost from the Star Market's seventh anniversary and a Shein listing greenlight.

- **Apple sues OpenAI** for alleged trade secret theft, escalating tensions in AI partnerships just as OpenAI consolidates power ahead of a prospective IPO ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/apple-openai-lawsuit-trade-secrets.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/openai-power-consolidates-under-co-founder-greg-brockman-ahead-of-ipo.html)).
- **SK Hynix surged 13%** in its Nasdaq debut, underscoring robust demand for memory chips from AI heavyweights like Nvidia and Apple ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-skhy-stock-nasdaq.html)).
- **Circle received a U.S. bank charter** from the OCC, propelling shares up 5% and signaling a new era of regulatory legitimacy for stablecoins ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/circle-gets-an-occ-bank-charter-as-stablecoin-competition-heats-up-shares-surge-14percent.html)).
- **The Trump administration eased export controls** for UAE-linked MGX, drawing sharp criticism from Senator Warren over a 'corrupt' provision tied to a Trump family stablecoin ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/trump-uae-mgx-crypto-export-commerce-warren.html)).
- **Shein finally won Chinese regulatory approval** for a Hong Kong IPO, a $50 billion valuation compromise after failed US and London attempts ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3360165/shein-receives-approval-hong-kong-ipo-chinese-regulators), [Kavout](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxOT0M5M09CNGhEd21TelIwV2QxYXpzSzlpQzQwS0V5ek82NGJVTGhHNDd1a05vWUo5Ni1jTkxTMk9QeThOVEtZZjl5STI5S3VzdkEwd1pWYmxJODJxZVpCaHhyTWJIc1JXY3JHd1BneVZIYXc3UDBZX3NPeDBrVmE3WWRRckpjLVd6clhiZGNocFJ6T1l1OGVvWThQT00tVkVyendYUDlR)).
- **European markets turned pensive** as US-Iran headlines fueled oil-supply anxiety, with product markets seen as the true chokepoint ([investingLive](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQT25MaFlULVpOd2RQbW1GQ2RHRWxxTEpEa2JOMG1kV1dXV0dzb0dzMUw1X0dKcnFvVjF1Z1ZBMHBsVHpXYlVQQlJyem5jOHlVMFRrc1AtNDQ4SHpvd3MxSzNNRGk4bm9wVC1QRVY3YTFxYTNRVzAyYjlCbWIweERoWnV3TWduOWlMblZYUTZmWWlLbjhqUUV5SFotdjhyVTYwQ3k1SmNYVTVGakx0dFJDdk43S0NuX2RLTkpNWDR4NA), [Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOTVZpNTRtS2laelVCbURzY2ZlMmxfZzdCNlRqR2xnUlVQbXpHUUZOaVFvOFNSZkllUHZBM0xNcnZiRk16cTdsaERrdU5UMWd6dFAzYl92bzFWa1pBN29yM0c1VkF4dEt4bGdqcHNQOTNFX2RwbXJpS2hpNjdDck90Nzcxb2h5b3pLci1ZTTV4SV9xUUl0S1RWeWlJdFFUa0lobGszX3drZw)).
- **Germany's bankruptcy boom** highlights Europe's biggest economy under strain, while Spain's common-debt proposal tests EU fiscal taboo ([Economic Times](https://news.google.), [Stratfor](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPRDFpRl9TQmx3VlY0UUJUdTFwcVFiWmhya1V4Sk9nc0h2X0d6T18zcTJXZGFaUHd6Q2hkZlZwYVoxVkphVnk0OEhnVEZ1V0tjdEE0U3lBY1V4NVBRTnN1eUJrWUtraVNzU3V4Rjlyd2JGbG4wYjByVl9nclpoNHpPNnQzUDFqT19MN1ZF)).
- **Chinese gold prices hold steady** at 1,255 yuan/gram, while June futures volume surged over 50% year-on-year, signaling strong speculative interest ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1fRFhFU0J0WHpUcHRDYmJsRDlsRFpLSmp0RGIwT0gtOG45WmozLUV5TVUxd0h5ay1UM2txWlVhQndFREpSZVVBWEFxZm5CVUdicmxJWFZMdU5KY2g2TEE)).

**Watch next:** The Apple-OpenAI lawsuit could reshape AI partnership models. Shein's HK IPO will test investor appetite for Chinese tech listings despite regulatory clouds. ECB's upgraded economic modelling and the fallout from US-Iran tensions will set the tone for European risk assets mid-week.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻呈现多重冲击：西班牙山火酿成惨剧，美伊对峙暂缓但威胁升级，科技巨头诉讼频发，东亚面临超强台风威胁。以下为关键动态：

- [西班牙山火已致12人死亡，含4名英国人，23人失踪](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 火灾规模为近年来最致命之一，政府紧急调派军队救援。
- [Meta发布AI改图功能仅数日即撤回](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dy6e8klw0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 因用户强烈反对生成不当内容，暴露AI伦理监管的失控风险。
- [美伊在霍尔木兹海峡冲突暂停，特朗普威胁“摧毁”伊朗](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/11/iran-war-live-us-demands-iran-publicly-state-strait-of-hormuz-open-for-all?traffic_source=rss) 谈判周六在阿曼重启，副总统万斯参与。
- [苹果起诉OpenAI窃取商业机密](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8w379e091o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 指控其硬件业务“烂到根”，科技巨头AI竞争白热化。
- [休斯顿ICE特工误杀平民，目标并非此人](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm2rm66xd17o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 移民执法失误引发民众对执法程序的质疑。
- [超强台风“巴威”逼近台湾和华南，菲律宾已致15死](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c04y6wr03gxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 风暴宽达1000公里，或为数十年来最强，日本南部已受影响。
- [SK海力士赴美IPO筹资265亿美元](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/10/south-korea-chip-maker-sk-hynix-rides-ai-boom-raising-265bn-in-huge-us-listing) AI芯片需求助推，成全球最大规模上市之一。

**后续观察**：科技与监管、气候灾害、地缘冲突仍是主线。美伊谈判若破裂可能引爆新冲突；台风登陆路径需持续关注；AI领域诉讼密集或重塑行业规则。
society.en:
In the last 24 hours, the world has witnessed a precarious pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities, a catastrophic wildfire in Spain, and the approach of a record-strength typhoon toward East Asia. Meanwhile, tech giants clash over AI, and financial markets brace for a massive semiconductor IPO.

- **U.S.-Iran tensions**: After two days of clashes, fighting appears to pause with negotiations resuming in Oman. Trump threatens 'decimation' if assassinated. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/11/iran-war-live-us-demands-iran-publicly-state-strait-of-hormuz-open-for-all?traffic_source=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/10/g-s1-132943/up-first-newsletter-iran-us-tps-haitians-syrians-eac-gaza-israel-hamas))
- **Spain wildfire**: At least 12 killed, 23 missing, four Britons among victims. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Typhoon Bavi**: 1,000 km-wide storm heading for Taiwan and SE China after killing 15 in the Philippines. Japan's southern islands lashed. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c04y6wr03gxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQRXRvY3dvSWFhN0ctWDN4dmo3WGZKTVB2YkREdVVtUkZ4ckt0bklDQm5vcGp1clNQWGcycy02eGFQaGRSYTNEbktYQWp2MGZKNlptdDNfdmxkTFAzZ1VHWThSY1Zvd3Q0Z1lhY1ljdmNPc3pRdVFPVnhrbEt3enNGWUVRREM))
- **Meta AI controversy**: Pulls new AI image feature after backlash over altering Instagram content. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dy6e8klw0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Apple sues OpenAI**: Alleging theft of trade secrets in a lawsuit Friday. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8w379e091o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **SK hynix mega listing**: South Korean chipmaker raises $26.5bn in US IPO, riding AI boom. ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/10/south-korea-chip-maker-sk-hynix-rides-ai-boom-raising-265bn-in-huge-us-listing))
- **Zulu king controversy**: Video of tirade against wife sparks regret and public outcry. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8dl9n1v3vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **China-North Korea diplomacy**: Xi and Kim exchange messages on 65th anniversary of friendship treaty. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9fWi12eFRTem54dGE2UkxZLUhQNkVQOTBraEtEUzgxT3lfZC1kVi04dkxsVnZnd290U05idDRRWkRMMlQxQnJXQk5fdDlQdEZZejdwaERjNXlqZGJmWHI1UHJpT0F2WWdoT1cySUpHVlQyRTNWSGJqU2t5T2ZlTE0))

**Watch next**: Monitor the Oman negotiations for a potential ceasefire, the landfall of Typhoon Bavi in Taiwan/China, and the evolving AI legal battles between Apple and OpenAI.

military.zh:
**导语**：今日全球军事焦点集中在多线并发：南海仲裁案十周年引发中菲博弈升级，菲律宾推动军费至GDP 4%；美以冲突后F-22转场欧洲，中东部署收缩；乌克兰远程打击深入俄本土，同时获许可生产爱国者导弹但需数年；多国加速高超音速与激光武器军备竞赛。

- **[菲律宾防长呼吁国防开支升至GDP 4%](https://news.google.)**：在西菲律宾海与中国紧张持续背景下，菲律宾明确将构建“可信威慑”，此举将深刻改变南海力量平衡，并与中方“不接受不承认”南海仲裁案立场形成直接对冲。
- **[F-22抵达英格兰结束伊朗部署](https://www.twz.com/air/f-22-raptors-arrive-in-england-after-deployment-to-israel-for-iran-war)**：美空军从中央司令部回撤五代机，同时中东局势仍面临伊朗报复风险，该动向表明美军正重新评估区域兵力梯次，但“战斗前景增长”的判断使撤回并非降级信号。
- **[乌克兰无人机打击俄南部炼油厂与亚速港](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE9HSDBKamNMZF81U0U5SkpTaXhiMVljeEU4d0NRRV9sMHZTZHN3eVpUTExfZWFTeHY3T3NnNjZMLXQwUFpnRUg3dGdCdzZUczdLX2pYbw)**：乌军持续战略袭城，俄方五死回应，同时乌克兰确认可获爱国者生产许可，但[官方评估称“可能需要数年”](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/ukraine-can-soon-build-its-own-patriots-but-it-could-take-years/)，泽连斯基另推动欧洲联合开发[更便宜的“Freya”反导系统](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/zelenskyy-taps-european-allies-to-build-freya-a-cheaper-patriot-alternative-to-russias-ballistic-missiles/)，显示西方援乌模式正从“交付成品”转向“授产赋能”。
- **[土耳其S-400转售谈判得到俄方确认](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-confirms-talks-with-turkey-over-fate-of-s-400s-amid-f-35-push)**：安卡拉正寻求将俄制防空系统转移至海湾国家，以换取美国解除F-35禁售，[Military Watch分析称此举可能改变中东反导格局](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQV3UzZ3Vqak94SDFxbkpnQzdfb3FuaW1WczRZUGZSLVVXWHZJOTNwdGVTU18tamREbWNGWFV1dkR6a2FnU3NDMTlOMW5YNnB0Qk0tenhzMGYtLThQb0xCX2NIb2F4MkxqQzM3eGRNZjc5YnphVlJTdDhZQlV4aTllNnBR)**，同时北约安卡拉峰会宣言强化高加索安全，土耳其战略杠杆显著提升。
- **[法国开发高超音速核导弹](https://news.google.)**，系于战斗机发射，选择速度优先于隐身；欧盟同步签署[HYDIS高超音速拦截器项目](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/eu-signs-grant-for-mbda-led-hydis-hypersonic-interceptor-project/)，德国海军宣布[2029年部署激光武器](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-navy-to-deploy-new-mbda-and-rheinmetall-laser-weapon-by-2029/)，欧洲正集中资源应对高超音速威胁。
- **[美海军正式调研韩国船厂建造驱逐舰与油船](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-rfi-south-korea-shipbuilding-destroyers/)**：此举若成行，将打破80年外国建造军舰禁令，[霍尔木兹海峡6月交通虽较5月翻倍但仍仅为去年同期的18%](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)，凸显美军需强化海上后勤与区域存在。

**后续观察**：未来24小时需关注菲律宾是否在南海采取实际动作、伊朗对以色列的潜在报复行动、乌克兰“Freya”反导项目首次联盟会议结果，以及美国是否会因韩国造船RFI引发本土造船业反弹。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have seen a flurry of activity across multiple theaters, from the South China Sea to the Persian Gulf and Ukraine. Tensions in the West Philippine Sea are escalating as Manila pushes for a massive defense budget hike, while the decennial anniversary of the South China Sea arbitration award triggers a new round of Chinese and Philippine rhetoric. In the Middle East, a complex realignment is underway as Turkey considers transferring S-400s to secure F-35 reinstatement, even as F-22s redeploy from Israel to England. Simultaneously, Ukraine is gaining license-based access to Patriot production and advocating for a cheaper European interceptor, and the German Navy commits to shipboard laser weapons by 2029. The U.S. Navy is breaking an 80-year tradition by exploring South Korean yards for destroyer and tanker construction.

- **Philippines seeks 4% GDP defense spending** to build credible deterrence against China in the West Philippine Sea, a significant escalation in fiscal commitment ([facebook.com](https://news.google.)).
- **Ukraine inches toward domestic Patriot production** after securing a U.S. license, but experts caution the capability remains years away ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/ukraine-can-soon-build-its-own-patriots-but-it-could-take-years/)); separately, Zelenskyy is rallying European allies behind the “Freya” alternative ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/zelenskyy-taps-european-allies-to-build-freya-a-cheaper-patriot-alternative-to-russias-ballistic-missiles/)).
- **Turkey’s S-400 saga takes a new turn** as Russia confirms talks over the systems’ fate amid Ankara’s push for F-35 access; a transfer to a Gulf state is reportedly under discussion ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-confirms-talks-with-turkey-over-fate-of-s-400s-amid-f-35-push)).
- **NATO’s Ankara Summit** marks a “third major strategic transformation” with implications for Caucasus and European security, as Turkey emerges with renewed influence ([Daily Sabah](https://news.google.)).
- **Strait of Hormuz traffic partially recovers** to 576 transits in June (up from 233 in May) but remains far below pre-crisis levels of 3,131 in June 2025, indicating persistent risk ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)).
- **German Navy signs contract for directed-energy weapon** development, aiming to field a laser weapon system by 2029 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-navy-to-deploy-new-mbda-and-rheinmetall-laser-weapon-by-2029/)).
- **U.S. Navy issues RFIs to South Korean shipbuilders** for destroyers and fleet oilers, a potential historic break from the “Build America” norm that could reshape global naval construction dynamics ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-rfi-south-korea-shipbuilding-destroyers/)).

**Watch next:** The interplay between Turkish S-400 diplomacy and F-35 normalization will be a key lever in NATO’s eastern flank posture. Meanwhile, the Pentagon’s move toward South Korean shipyards could trigger a wave of consolidation and political debate in U.S. defense manufacturing. In the Indo-Pacific, any further Chinese escalation on Philippine reefs may force Manila’s defense budget hike from proposal to law faster than expected.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现多重冲突：AI行业价格战、安全高管离职与苹果诉讼交织，Meta因争议撤回AI功能；汽车领域中国电动车在澳大利亚全面主导，小米推出续航超1500公里的增程式SUV；科技产品方面，美国CISA网络安全事件暴露自身漏洞，FCC打击DJI绕过禁令，纽约推出“点击即取消”订阅规则；HackNews社区热议战争地图、爱因斯坦相对论等宏大话题。

- AI价格战持续升级，Meta以巨额支出推高竞争，同时因全球争议撤回Instagram的AI生成图像功能——[Meta removes AI feature on Instagram after global backlash](https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/science-and-technology/700735/missed-the-mark-meta-removes-ai-feature-on-instagram-after-global-backlash)。
- OpenAI安全负责人Johannes Heidecke离职，苹果以窃取商业机密为由起诉OpenAI，AI安全与监管博弈加剧——[OpenAI Safety Head Heidecke to Leave Firm](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-11/openai-safety-head-heidecke-to-leave-firm-after-reshuffle-wired) & [Apple sues OpenAI](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy8w379e091o)。
- 中国电动车在澳大利亚市场实现历史性突破：7月销量前七名全为中国制造或中国品牌，包括特斯拉上海工厂生产的Model Y——[Australia’s 7 best-selling EVs are now all Chinese](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/australia-top-7-evs-all-chinese/)。
- 小米发布首款增程式SUV SkyNomad N90，目标直指理想汽车与华为问界，综合续航超1500公里——[Xiaomi reveals SkyNomad N90](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/xiaomi-skynomad-n90-erev-suv/)。
- 美国CISA在应对安全事件时被迫边做边建事件响应手册，暴露联邦网络安全准备不足——[US cybersecurity agency CISA had to build its incident playbook during the incident](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/us-cyber-agency-cisa-had-to-build-its-incident-playbook-during-the-incident-agency-reveals/)。
- FCC加大力度打击DJI利用空壳公司绕过美国无人机禁令的行为——[The FCC is cracking down on DJI tech that dodged the foreign drone ban](https://www.theverge.com/policy/964342/fcc-crack-down-dji-front-companies-xtra-skyrover-sgs-lab)。
- 纽约市市长宣布“点击即取消”规则，要求订阅服务必须提供与订阅同样简便的取消方式——[Mamdani announces new Click-to-Cancel rule for New York City](https://www.engadget.com/2212741/mamdani-announces-new-click-to-cancel-rule-for-new-york-city/)。
- SpaceX计划向FCC申请批准发射10万颗额外Starlink卫星，带宽可提升100倍——[SpaceX wants to launch 100k more Starlink satellites for 100x the bandwidth](https://www.zdnet.com/home-and-office/networking/spacex-wants-to-launch-100000-more-starlink-satellites/)。

**后续观察**：AI领域内部冲突与外部诉讼可能加速行业整合与监管落地；中国电动车厂商凭借成本优势与产品力在全球市场攻城略地，美国或效仿欧洲施加新关税；科技监管方面，从订阅取消到无人机禁令执行，政府介入意图明显。投资者应关注大科技公司因AI军备竞赛而膨胀的债务（@Bloomberg），以及CISA事件引发的联邦IT安全反思。
tech.en:
The tech landscape this week is defined by a dramatic shake-up in the AI industry, with legal action, internal resignations, and a major feature rollback signaling a new phase of accountability. Simultaneously, the automotive sector sees Chinese brands dominating global EV sales and regulators tightening rules on autonomous driving. Policy battles over surveillance, subscription practices, and space expansion also dominate headlines.

- **AI at a crossroads**: [Apple sues OpenAI](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy8w379e091o) over trade secret theft, while [Meta removes its controversial Instagram AI feature](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/meta-removes-controversial-ai-feature-on-instagram-after-backlash/) after global backlash. OpenAI’s [safety head Johannes Heidecke departs](https://www.wired.com/story/openai-head-of-safety-leaving/) amid a reshuffle, and [Big Tech debt hits $350B](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-10/big-tech-doubles-debt-load-to-350-billion-in-ai-spending-spree) to fund the AI spending spree, with [Meta leading the price war](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE4ybnctUzBUcktITUxid1NZQTQ2dFlPOHp6dmZfNC1QeEIyS3FTRVpRSngySzlSeGRNRVVZTmdNNXk3TXpHUWRvclJoQU01VXFBM0RKaGNpNFBVVmRXdkpPR0Z3aFNBUktJZjAxWkh2M3o).
- **EV market upheaval**: [Xiaomi unveils SkyNomad N90](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/xiaomi-skynomad-n90-erev-suv/), a full-size EREV SUV with 932-mile range, directly challenging Li Auto. [BYD updates its $10,000 Seagull](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/byds-10k-seagull-ev-revealed-longer-body-more-upgrades/) with a longer body. In the US, [NHTSA may drop the steering wheel requirement](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9sREo5Wl9qWlRiMGNzLTVUeF9KM3FId1p0c2drUDl0QkdhREdtbDFUS0t2ams5d0xVYTZ1dU9rRWlrcno1ZzA1RWpjT0dQQVlYcG1uMFZSOHRFSHk4RXYtcTZTOWIwVTJSVGdmeWVVWXQ0QQ) for driverless cars, while [New Jersey’s robotaxi bill specifically writes out Tesla](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE54Z1lZbGhLczVWTlg2V2xkR3laOC1BWHFaaVA3dlVTNGJkODFqbDJnTjY1QlBmTUhHWWZLcEhOU0k3Vk5iSjNuUHlDY0JSM192RW1kXzZCNklaQ1ZCVVNndjloZDdCbDZnb3c).
- **China’s rocket reuse milestone**: [China recovered its first reusable rocket](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/07/china-recovered-its-first-reusable-rocket-and-showed-a-new-way-to-do-it/), showcasing a new landing method and intensifying the space race.
- **CISA caught flat-footed**: A security breach exposed that [CISA had to write its incident response playbook during the actual incident](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/us-cyber-agency-cisa-had-to-build-its-incident-playbook-during-the-incident-agency-reveals/), after passwords were leaked via a contractor’s GitHub repo.
- **Bill Gates’ daughter’s startup accused of fraud**: [Phia, co-founded by Phoebe Gates, is accused of “cookie stuffing”](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/phia-accused-of-cookie-stuffing-taking-affiliate-credit-on-purchases-it-didnt-earn/) to claim affiliate commissions it didn’t earn.
- **SpaceX dreams big again**: The company [plans to launch 100,000 more Starlink satellites](https://www.zdnet.com/home-and-office/networking/spacex-wants-to-launch-100000-more-starlink-satellites/) for 100x bandwidth, sparking intense discussion on Hacker News.
- **Regulation moves**: [New York City enacts a “Click to Cancel” rule](https://www.engadget.com/2212741/mamdani-announces-new-click-to-cancel-rule-for-new-york-city/) for subscriptions, and the [FCC cracks down on DJI’s front companies](https://www.theverge.com/policy/964342/fcc-crack-down-dji-front-companies-xtra-skyrover-sgs-lab) that bypass the US drone ban.

**Watch next**: The fallout from Apple’s lawsuit against OpenAI could reshape the talent market. Tesla’s exclusion from New Jersey’s robotaxi bill may set a precedent for other states. And the rapid expansion of Starlink will face regulatory and orbital debris scrutiny.
