### 📰 体育新闻日报 | 2026-07-11

昨夜今晨，体育世界迎来多个历史性时刻：世界杯赛场西班牙凭借梅里诺的替补绝杀淘汰比利时，英格兰备战挪威虎视眈眈；网球温网男单决赛对阵出炉，辛纳完胜德约科维奇，兹维列夫击败本土黑马费里；板球、橄榄球、UFC等各有焦点。中国篮球裁判张潇亮相NBA夏季联赛，标志中国裁判走向世界；羽毛球年终总决赛临近，赛事动态值得关注。

- 🇪🇸 **世界杯：西班牙绝杀比利时，梅里诺再演英雄** — 替补出场仅3分钟，梅里诺在第88分钟打入致胜球，帮助西班牙2‑1击败比利时，晋级半决赛对阵法国。比利时门将拉门斯的一次低级失误让球队付出代价，也意味着比利时“黄金一代”的世界杯之旅很可能就此终结（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy107g38eo)）。梅里诺从半年前还在骑代步车的重伤中恢复，如今成为国家队关键先生（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562417/mikel-merino-arsenal-midfielder-proving-spains-world-cup-hero-after-overcoming-injury-that-left-him-in-mobility-scooter)）。
- 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 **英格兰备战挪威，伤病与停赛阴影** — 赖斯、格希、里斯·詹姆斯均参加赛前训练，但贾雷尔·夸安萨的红牌追加两场停赛仍无官方解释，图赫尔公开表达不满（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562219/thomas-tuchel-reveals-england-still-yet-to-receive-explanation-over-jarell-quansahs-upgraded-two-game-suspension-after-mexico-red-card)）。挪威主帅承认英格兰是晋级热门（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cq61n2gqqv0o)）。厄德高在世界杯上助攻等多项数据领跑全队（[虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE04eWFUOXZaQ2ppVmhuV1VwejY0Z0lubkdWQ1VXMGJGOE5BZGEzamFPYzFnRWQ2cE1NTFJSdUZCNTQ5UjlwSHl5VFRlQVBIZEptcmo2dGFhcw)）。
- 🎾 **温网男单决赛：辛纳 vs. 兹维列夫** — 卫冕冠军辛纳以3个6‑4横扫德约科维奇，终结后者争夺第八冠的梦想（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/tennis/news/12040/13562360/wimbledon-2026-clinical-jannik-sinner-outclasses-novak-djokovic-to-set-up-final-against-alexander-zverev)）；兹维列夫则在半决赛击败英国外卡费里，首次晋级温网决赛（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/ckg475qdnd7o)）。德约科维奇“既幸运又受诅咒”——半决赛加澳网亚军对一般人来说是荣耀，对他却是沮丧（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/c33yxe5npnxo)）。
- 🏏 **板球：英格兰女队创纪录，新秀首秀惊艳** — 索菲·埃克尔斯通在洛德球场打破英格兰女队全格式最高 wicket 纪录，而新秀马迪·维利尔斯在测试赛首日表现“极其出色”（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12040/13562397/england-vs-india-mady-villiers-hugely-impressive-on-dream-test-debut-at-lords-but-is-hard-slog-ahead-for-hosts)）。
- ⚡ **UFC 329：霍洛威增重升次中，迎战麦格雷戈** — 前羽量级冠军马克斯·霍洛威完成次中量级转型，本周六将与康纳·麦格雷戈进行二番战（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/mixed-martial-arts/articles/c4gy10403j4o)）。
- 🇨🇳 **中国篮球裁判亮相 NBA 夏联** — 裁判张潇执裁夏季联赛焦点战，标志着中国篮球裁判体系国际化迈出重要一步（[球迷屋](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE5zQXU5Q29GNUFnMWJfcUJlV253c2tMcDd5YlR6QTBVQkpUUTVFUXNyTjZYM29rS3ZUVjJ3eWVGMGVCbG02RWluZE1DeFh5dzc0aTUweg)）。
- 🤼 **Wigan 青年军击败 Warrington，紧追利兹** — 超级联赛中，维根年轻球员闪耀，30‑18战胜沃灵顿，保持对榜首利兹的压力（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/rugby-league/news/12040/13562383/wigan-warriors-30-18-warrington-wolves-hosts-keep-pressure-on-leeds-rhinos-as-youngsters-shine-in-win)）。

**📌 后续观察**：世界杯半决赛西班牙vs法国、英格兰vs挪威即将上演，梅里诺能否延续神奇？辛纳与兹维列夫的温网决赛将上演新一代对决；中国篮球裁判张潇在夏联后续执法表现值得关注。羽毛球年终总决赛种子名单与签表即将发布，国羽选手动态将成热点。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by World Cup quarter-final drama, with Spain edging Belgium in a late thriller and England preparing to face Norway. Wimbledon saw Jannik Sinner dethrone Novak Djokovic, while Alexander Zverev ended British wildcard Arthur Fery's dream run. In MMA, Max Holloway's welterweight transformation sets up a McGregor rematch. China's basketball referees made headlines at the NBA Summer League, and the BWF World Tour Finals remain the focus for badminton.

- **World Cup Shock**: Mikel Merino's 88th-minute winner for Spain vs Belgium (2-1) ends Belgium's golden generation era. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy107g38eo) | [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562417/mikel-merino-arsenal-midfielder-proving-spains-world-cup-hero-after-overcoming-injury-that-left-him-in-mobility-scooter)
- **England's Quarter-final Prep**: Declan Rice, Marc Guehi, and Reece James train ahead of Saturday's clash vs Norway. Norway boss admits England are favourites. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o) | [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cq61n2gqqv0o)
- **Wimbledon Men's Final Set**: Defending champion Jannik Sinner beats Novak Djokovic in straight sets; Alexander Zverev overcomes Arthur Fery. [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/tennis/news/12040/13562360/wimbledon-2026-clinical-jannik-sinner-outclasses-novak-djokovic-to-set-up-final-against-alexander-zverev) | [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/ckg475qdnd7o)
- **UFC 329**: Max Holloway completes welterweight transformation for McGregor showdown. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/mixed-martial-arts/articles/c4gy10403j4o)
- **Cricket: England Women's Test**: Sophie Ecclestone becomes England's leading wicket-taker; Mady Villiers impresses on debut. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/cwylvdn7gdyo) | [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12040/13562397/england-vs-india-mady-villiers-hugely-impressive-on-dream-test-debut-at-lords-but-is-hard-slog-ahead-for-hosts)
- **Manchester United Transfer**: £35m deal for Atalanta midfielder Ederson in doubt. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c9d2z59596eo)
- **China Basketball Referees**: Zhang Xiao officiates a key NBA Summer League game, showcasing Chinese referee development. [球迷屋](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE5zQXU5Q29GNUFnMWJfcUJlV253c2tMcDd5YlR6QTBVQkpUUTVFUXNyTjZYM29rS3ZUVjJ3eWVGMGVCbG02RWluZE1DeFh5dzc0aTUweg)

**Watch next**: All eyes are on Saturday's World Cup quarter-finals, particularly England vs Norway and the fallout from Belgium's exit. The Wimbledon men's final between Sinner and Zverev promises high drama, while UFC 329 could redefine two weight classes.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块AI争议与行业震荡交织。诺兰盛赞年轻导演“彻底拒绝AI垃圾”，Meta则在压力下撤回AI图像生成器，娱乐圈与科技巨头的博弈进入新阶段。同时，多位幕后功臣离世，包括《好莱坞往事》奥斯卡级美术指导Barbara Ling（73岁）、迪士尼放映先驱Don Iwerks（96岁）以及《警察学院2》演员Peter Van Norden（75岁），行业失去一批宝贵的记忆。商业层面，Scripps旗下54家地方电视台与DirecTV僵持五周后和解，派拉蒙与华纳探索的合并也在俄勒冈州总检察长的让步中扫清一个障碍。日韩方面，TXT成员然竣刷新今年韩流solo首日销量纪录，KiiiKiii宣布8月回归；中国微博上虞书欣“蚌精仿妆”引爆28亿阅读，多名艺人公开“讨债”登上热搜，横店影视基地推出新政试图提振行业。以下是分板块详情：

- [Christopher Nolan Praises Gen Z Filmmakers For “Utterly Rejecting” AI Slop](https://deadline.com/2026/07/christopher-nolan-praises-gen-z-utterly-rejecting-ai-1236979769/)
- [Zucked Up! Meta Disables AI Image Generator After CAA & SAG-AFTRA Trashed It](https://deadline.com/2026/07/meta-disables-new-ai-image-generator-zuckerberg-1236979706/)
- [Barbara Ling, Oscar-Winning Production Designer on ‘Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,’ Dies at 73](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/barbara-ling-dead-once-upon-time-hollywood-production-designer-1236644433/)
- [Don Iwerks, Disney Camera and Projection Pioneer, Dies at 96](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/don-iwerks-dead-disney-camera-legend-1236644425/)
- [Scripps’ 54 Local Stations Return To DirecTV After Five-Week Blackout](https://deadline.com/2026/07/scripps-directv-retransmission-battle-tv-stations-go-dark-1236931598/)
- [Oregon AG Drops Demand For Records & Motion To Delay Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery Merger](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-oregon-attorney-general-motion-1236979773/)
- [TXTYeonjun Achieves Highest 1st-Day Sales Of Any Korean Soloist In 2026](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853805wpp/txts-yeonjun-achieves-highest-1st-day-sales-of-any-korean-soloist-in-2026-with-no-labels-part-02)
- [28亿阅读！虞书欣蚌精仿妆为何刷屏全网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBHazFwMzFVZU5Jenp6X05GN2hDUWprbkJoNFAxcnQ0QThvTGQ1MVJtWXp2WjI0eVljY3pvZWtVWTROaVVqR1l2XzBCRnBweGFYOTQtdWc5dDRQX01rM1laeDBYYUNBT0V4aWZIVmFsVThuQQ)

后续观察：AI在影视创作中的角色正成为好莱坞内外分裂线，Meta的退缩可能为其他平台带来监管示范；同时秋季合并窗口开启，派拉蒙与华纳探索的交易仍面临多州调查，结果将重塑传统制片厂格局。中国横店新政能否实质提振产能，值得持续关注。
entertainment.en:
Entertainment news this week features a notable trio of industry deaths, a major merger moving forward, and escalating backlash against AI in Hollywood. Meanwhile, K-pop continues to dominate sales charts, and Chinese social media buzzes with celebrity feuds and viral moments.

- Three industry veterans died: Oscar-winning production designer Barbara Ling ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/barbara-ling-dead-once-upon-time-hollywood-production-designer-1236644433/)), Disney camera pioneer Don Iwerks ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/don-iwerks-dead-disney-exec-1236979775/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/artisans/news/donald-iwerks-dead-disney-camera-technician-iwerks-entertainment-1236807071/)), and actor Peter Van Norden ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/peter-van-norden-dead-1236979743/)).
- The Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger cleared a hurdle as Oregon AG dropped demands for records and a motion to delay; the deal could close as soon as July 22 ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-oregon-attorney-general-motion-1236979773/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/oregon-paramount-warner-bros-merger-drops-delay-1236807068/)).
- Christopher Nolan praised Gen Z filmmakers for rejecting "AI slop," calling it the most rapid dismissal of a foundational tech jump he has seen ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/christopher-nolan-praises-gen-z-utterly-rejecting-ai-1236979769/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/christopher-nolan-young-audiences-reject-ai-slop-1236644273/)).
- Meta disabled its Muse AI image generator after CAA and SAG-AFTRA criticized privacy concerns; the company admitted they "missed the mark" ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/meta-disables-new-ai-image-generator-zuckerberg-1236979706/)).
- In K-pop, TXT's Yeonjun achieved the highest first-day sales of any Korean soloist in 2026 with "NO LABELS: PART 02" ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853805wpp/txts-yeonjun-achieves-highest-1st-day-sales-of-any-korean-soloist-in-2026-with-no-labels-part-02)); KiiiKiii confirmed an August comeback ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853815wpp/kiiikiii-confirms-plans-for-august-comeback)).
- On Chinese social media, "multiple celebrities demand debt repayment" trended ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQOTVwNi1hdWRpdUZrTkJpYVJGaWk1M1d4dzFOOTVoWGZmLVBqVkhXUVNMVGJKSHJxNVNOLWMtd0hvWTlxTkUyRmdFblJsNE5Gd2dnWFlVN05mTWFvQ3gzcmpLc2hlM3ExQWM4OF9WeUNmS2dxY2F3RE9hRld4SjI1b1Q1S21VS2V0c29V)), and actress Yu Shuxin's "clam makeup" garnered 2.8 billion reads ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFBHazFwMzFVZU5Jenp6X05GN2hDUWprbkJoNFAxcnQ0QThvTGQ1MVJtWXp2WjI0eVljY3pvZWtVWTROaVVqR1l2XzBCRnBweGFYOTQtdWc5dDRQX01rM1laeDBYYUNBT0V4aWZIVmFsVThuQQ)).
- Jack White offered an opening slot to "Satanic" band Twin Temple after Charley Crockett dropped them, sparking a split in the devil-rock scene ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jack-white-satanic-band-twin-temple-charley-crockett-1236807060/)).

Watch next: Keep an eye on the Paramount-WBD merger closing date and further AI regulation changes in Hollywood, as well as the August K-pop comeback season and ongoing Chinese celebrity legal battles over defamation.

美股.zh:
美股昨日小幅走强，但结构分化加剧。苹果起诉OpenAI窃密，市场担忧科技联盟裂痕，同时Meta被交易员重新看好显示AI板块轮流炒作。政策层面，Circle获银行牌照引发稳定币金融化想象，而特朗普拒签住房法案则让市场聚焦自动生效后的执行。SK海力士纳斯达克首日飙升13%，证实AI硬件需求仍然旺盛。

- 苹果起诉OpenAI（[Apple sues OpenAI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/apple-openai-lawsuit-trade-secrets.html)）：2024年合作iPhone集成ChatGPT可能面临解体，影响AI应用生态。
- Circle获OCC银行牌照（[Circle bank charter](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/circle-gets-an-occ-bank-charter-as-stablecoin-competition-heats-up-shares-surge-14percent.html)）：稳定币从支付工具向银行业务跃迁，监管红利助推股价。
- SK海力士上市（[SK Hynix rises 13%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-skhy-stock-nasdaq.html)）：万亿市值背后是英伟达和苹果的算力需求，但高估值需业绩持续兑现。
- AI竞赛模式切换（[AI race shifting](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/the-ai-race-is-shifting-from-bigger-models-to-cheaper-smarter-systems.html)）：按任务选择模型将降低对顶尖GPU的依赖，Hynix等硬件厂商需应对长期结构变化。

美股短期受AI热点驱动，但苹果-OpenAI诉讼可能引发科技板块波动，投资者需警惕合作破裂带来的供应链调整。
美股.en:
US equities edged higher as Wall Street's appetite for AI winners remained insatiable, but a blistering Apple lawsuit against OpenAI and a controversial UAE export-control waiver injected fresh regulatory and political risk into the tech trade. The session also saw a landmark crypto bank charter and a surge in SK Hynix's debut.

- **Apple sues OpenAI** for trade-secret theft, alleging a scheme that 'permeated every level' of the AI firm. This comes after their high-profile 2024 ChatGPT-iPhone integration, raising questions about IP safeguards in AI partnerships ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/apple-openai-lawsuit-trade-secrets.html)).
- **SK Hynix soared 13%** on its Nasdaq debut, with its chairman telling CNBC 'demand is enormous' from AI giants like Nvidia and Apple. The memory-chip maker now has a trillion-dollar market cap ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-skhy-stock-nasdaq.html)).
- **Circle received a U.S. trust bank charter** from the OCC, sending shares up 5% and legitimizing stablecoins in traditional banking. The move intensifies competition in the stablecoin space ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/circle-gets-an-occ-bank-charter-as-stablecoin-competition-heats-up-shares-surge-14percent.html)).
- **Trump admin eases export controls** for UAE's MGX, tied to a Trump-family-linked stablecoin used in a $2B Binance investment. Senator Warren blasted the provision as 'corrupt' ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/trump-uae-mgx-crypto-export-commerce-warren.html)).
- **The AI race is shifting** from bigger models to cheaper, smarter systems, as companies choose AI by task and cost rather than benchmark rank. This trend could benefit Meta's comeback bid after a year-long share drought ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/the-ai-race-is-shifting-from-bigger-models-to-cheaper-smarter-systems.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/10/traders-fall-back-in-love-with-meta-heres-where-bulls-see-it-going.html)).

**Signal:** The AI sector faces a pivot from partnership euphoria to IP litigation, while the crypto-banking nexus gains regulatory momentum. Watch for Apple-OpenAI legal developments and Circle's charter impact on fintech valuations.

中国经济.zh:
中国一季度经济数据平稳，但结构亮点集中。Shein终获证监会批准赴港上市，第三次尝试终获突破；科创板七周年，科技企业融资功能强化。北京中关村AI与芯片企业扩张推高写字楼租金，显示产业集聚效应；BlackRock首席策略师认为中国作为组合分散工具的价值上升。

- Shein获香港IPO批准（[Shein receives approval](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3360165/shein-receives-approval-hong-kong-ipo-chinese-regulators)）：发行341.6百万股，估值约500亿美元，考验海外资本对中国供应链模式接受度。
- 科创板七周年（[Star Market at 7](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360094/star-market-7-tech-centric-stock-exchange-powers-chinas-innovation-rise)）：支持前沿科技突破，但需关注部分标的高估值与盈利能力落差。
- 中关村租金逆势上涨（[Expanding AI and chip firms push up rents](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360154/expanding-ai-and-chip-firms-push-rents-beijings-hi-tech-district)）：全国写字楼市场低迷，但AI/芯片企业抢租带火单一区域。
- BlackRock称中国为分散化工具（[China’s appeal as portfolio diversifier](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360071/chinas-appeal-portfolio-diversifier-grows-blackrock-strategist-says)）：与全球高通胀和波动环境形成对照，外资增配中国权益的趋势值得跟踪。

Shein IPO将成为下半年中资境外融资的风向标，若定价合理可提振市场情绪；但注意监管层对跨境数据流动的审查仍存变数。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets saw a significant catalyst as Shein received long-awaited regulatory approval for a Hong Kong IPO, while Beijing's tech hub rents rose on AI demand and the Star Market celebrated seven years of fueling innovation. Global asset manager BlackRock highlighted China's growing appeal as a portfolio diversifier.

- **Shein wins CSRC approval** for a Hong Kong IPO after failed New York and London attempts. The fast-fashion giant plans to issue up to 341.6 million shares, with a valuation around $50 billion ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3360165/shein-receives-approval-hong-kong-ipo-chinese-regulators), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPRUNNTVNVXzJTN3FSaDhQSU5FTzhEdldaaHdva194ZVgxM1AxWV90QmhJbmpzejMyQUxRUVBsZTFvVzU3NER3M1h3T2d6R1FpcjR0NkVsYkluMS01SW9vbVM5UE5oR3kwMXFNV0tuaGYxT2ljVVlmcGJqRjVXMDlhZTdPZ0hSS3hl)).
- **Star Market at 7:** The tech-centric exchange has become a 'financial engine' for breakthroughs in AI, robotics, and semiconductors, according to SCMP. It remains a key pillar of China's innovation push ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360094/star-market-7-tech-centric-stock-exchange-powers-chinas-innovation-rise)).
- **AI and chip firms drive up rents** in Beijing's Zhongguancun, the only submarket to post rent growth amid a struggling national office market. Demand for grade-A offices from tech firms is fueling a localized property hotspot ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3360154/expanding-ai-and-chip-firms-push-rents-beijings-hi-tech-district)).
- **BlackRock strategist Li Wei** said China's appeal as a portfolio diversifier is growing due to changing correlations and higher inflation, offering exposure to different economic drivers ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360071/chinas-appeal-portfolio-diversifier-grows-blackrock-strategist-says)).

**Signal:** Shein's IPO will be a bellwether for Chinese tech listings abroad. Combined with the Star Market's resilience and BlackRock's endorsement, the narrative is shifting toward selective bullishness on Chinese equities.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲经济昨日承压，德国破产潮与西班牙债务提案形成对比。欧央行公布6月会议纪要（[Meeting of 10-11 June 2026](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/accounts/2026/html/ecb.mg260709~0e7f8241c9.en.html)），显示对通胀粘性的担忧；同时欧央行首席经济学家Lane探讨AI对货币政策的影响（[Philip R. Lane: AI and monetary policy](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260706~b81aa4e329.en.html)），预示政策工具面临技术变革。

- 德国破产潮（[Bankruptcy boom](https://news.google.)）：欧洲最大经济体企业密集违约，反映能源成本与出口需求双重压力。
- 西班牙共同债务提案（[Spain Broaches EU Taboo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPRDFpRl9TQmx3VlY0UUJUdTFwcVFiWmhya1V4Sk9nc0h2X0d6T18zcTJXZGFaUHd6Q2hkZlZwYVoxVkphVnk0OEhnVEZ1V0tjdEE0U3lBY1V4NVBRTnN1eUJrWUtraVNzU3V4Rjlyd2JGbG4wYjByVl9nclpoNHpPNnQzUDFqT19MN1ZF)）：挑战德法等国财政纪律，若获得进展将改变欧盟金融市场结构。
- 欧央行模型升级（[ECB upgrades economic modelling](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE9CcDZfcmxSUmZIWjJjd0FhWXNXdmxlakdQc29lbVVzTmJ5UDBDdElvZDB0XzFuT19ub2xla3FVbU1WdnlFZ0VXQy1USDRCWThXT0dfeTJKY3BYUEpJVGVHNThRUTJVS01Kdnpmb2RfZFhRV0I5VTJ1Z1N4aXdydw)）：在不确定性加剧背景下，可能影响未来货币政策路径。
- 美国伊朗局势影响欧洲市场情绪（[investingLive European session wrap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQT25MaFlULVpOd2RQbW1GQ2RHRWxxTEpEa2JOMG1kV1dXV0dzb0dzMUw1X0dKcnFvVjF1Z1ZBMHBsVHpXYlVQQlJyem5jOHlVMFRrc1AtNDQ4SHpvd3MxSzNNRGk4bm9wVC1QRVY3YTFxYTNRVzAyYjlCbWIweERoWnV3TWduOWlMblZYUTZmWWlLbjhqUUV5SFotdjhyVTYwQ3k1SmNYVTVGakx0dFJDdk43S0NuX2RLTkpNWDR4NA)）：能源价格与避险情绪主导。

欧洲面临结构性矛盾：南部国家主张财政扩张与北部国家坚持紧缩之间的博弈将加剧市场波动。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets turned cautious amid geopolitical jitters over US-Iran tensions, while the ECB released its June meeting account and upgraded economic modelling. A corporate bankruptcy boom in Germany and Spain's push for common debt issuance added fiscal-policy layers to the region's outlook.

- **US-Iran headlines sour mood:** Markets digested the risk of a blockade, with oil product markets seen as the real chokepoint. The European session ended 'more pensive' as investors weighed supply disruptions ([investingLive](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQT25MaFlULVpOd2RQbW1GQ2RHRWxxTEpEa2JOMG1kV1dXV0dzb0dzMUw1X0dKcnFvVjF1Z1ZBMHBsVHpXYlVQQlJyem5jOHlVMFRrc1AtNDQ4SHpvd3MxSzNNRGk4bm9wVC1QRVY3YTFxYTNRVzAyYjlCbWIweERoWnV3TWduOWlMblZYUTZmWWlLbjhqUUV5SFotdjhyVTYwQ3k1SmNYVTVGakx0dFJDdk43S0NuX2RLTkpNWDR4NA), [Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOTVZpNTRtS2laelVCbURzY2ZlMmxfZzdCNlRqR2xnUlVQbXpHUUZOaVFvOFNSZkllUHZBM0xNcnZiRk16cTdsaERrdU5UMWd6dFAzYl92bzFWa1pBN29yM0c1VkF4dEt4bGdqcHNQOTNFX2RwbXJpS2hpNjdDck90Nzcxb2h5b3pLci1ZTTV4SV9xUUl0S1RWeWlJdFFUa0lobGszX3drZw)).
- **ECB meeting account released** for June 10-11. Separately, the ECB upgraded its economic modelling to better handle uncertainty, which could impact how crypto markets interpret policy signals ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/accounts/2026/html/ecb.mg260709~0e7f8241c9.en.html), [Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE9CcDZfcmxSUmZIWjJjd0FhWXNXdmxlakdQc29lbVVzTmJ5UDBDdElvZDB0XzFuT19ub2xla3FVbU1WdnlFZ0VXQy1USDRCWThXT0dfeTJKY3BYUEpJVGVHNThRUTJVS01Kdnpmb2RfZFhRV0I5VTJ1Z1N4aXdydw)).
- **Germany faces bankruptcy boom** in Europe's largest economy, signaling deepening corporate stress. Meanwhile, Spain floated a common debt proposal, testing EU fiscal taboo ([Economic Times](https://news.google.), [Stratfor](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxPRDFpRl9TQmx3VlY0UUJUdTFwcVFiWmhya1V4Sk9nc0h2X0d6T18zcTJXZGFaUHd6Q2hkZlZwYVoxVkphVnk0OEhnVEZ1V0tjdEE0U3lBY1V4NVBRTnN1eUJrWUtraVNzU3V4Rjlyd2JGbG4wYjByVl9nclpoNHpPNnQzUDFqT19MN1ZF)).
- **EURC records network growth,** hinting at a shift in Europe's crypto economy. The stablecoin's rise could benefit from the ECB's favourable view of digital transformation ([Bitget](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5PUW14Um5yUmlUdW9yd1Z3TVdoeFpGUFBfNG1zaWlVYXRLaTZoTDIyVlJBODFxVmtkUXpTdkdYcGUzd3EyQ2JQYXFOa0NFdzU2QzhYdWZyZmVOX013TzR5aExqd9IBY0FVX3lxTE5PUW14Um5yUmlUdW9yd1Z3TVdoeFpGUFBfNG1zaWlVYXRLaTZoTDIyVlJBODFxVmtkUXpTdkdYcGUzd3EyQ2JQYXFOa0NFdzU2QzhYdWZyZmVOX013TzR5aExqdw)).

**Signal:** Geopolitical risk from Iran and domestic corporate fragility in Germany are pulling Europe in opposite directions. ECB modelling upgrades and Spain's debt proposal could redefine the region's policy response in H2.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
同花顺社区热度集中于题材股与公告驱动。军工板块强势拉升，千亿龙头涨停；半导体概念因公司收购复牌受追捧；金饰价格稳定但投资者更关注低价题材。招商证券预增百亿元引发浮盈能否持续讨论，而000980连续亏损被证监会立案则是风险警示。

- 军工装备爆发（[军工装备8股爆了](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE83em1qVlFkUU9rTWxqMEVMdXZmODFMdmpTYUNUXzlwMUp3MHJyODh4RUFzOWRLRjlPNHFhdmlGZmJIYXRjdjFSQXdZYkpDZTlpZC15WlB3cUEtWVAxcjdPc2x3)）：千亿级龙头1分钟拉涨停，反映市场对地缘紧张局势和政策预期的投机情绪。
- 半导体收购案（[拟收购半导体公司！5倍大牛股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBvTjJGTlJVb2J5YnVnSFFvMmN4NHBxeWxtU3ZqRHJvSVNKUDBIWkNjbXo2YnZxalNybTIwVkJBU3o5MmZzenRISEJqeDdyZHlMc3BFMGM0dDJzbldJbWlvVFF3)）：5倍牛股复牌，市场期待资产注入，但需警惕前期涨幅透支。
- 招商证券浮盈百亿（[百亿元预增成色几何？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE55MzRCQk41ZmdBel8wZFlFal9QRlRUMllwai1HaVNubGkzU2tJSVNmRERVd09ha21CMU1ESFlTejdpdnZYTXBCTGhxNGkwcXltbHE4dzlVM2w4Y1NXR2ExM3dR)）：科创板收益贡献大但持续性存疑，社区讨论分歧明显。
- 风险案例：000980被立案（[000980，突发！涉嫌信披违规](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1OWnNXTXB6bkxJcnFnT0lmMzVoaGxmWjh5LUk5eF9kUjVoMUpaXzhoQkVhNFFzN0g0NUdXYk1tODlIU2ZPZy1zVV9IVTY0TWhZTUhyTFBZaGdXYVVVYU8wanN3)），连续7年亏损、负债率99%，警示高杠杆标的退市风险。

社区情绪整体偏积极，但缺乏基本面锚定，散户追高风险加大，需关注后续政策面变化对题材的支撑力度。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investors are showing robust activity: gold prices held steady near record highs, June futures volume surged over 50%, and a military-equipment stock rally caught fire. Meanwhile, a semiconductor stock suspended for acquisition and a firm investigated for disclosure violations added to the speculative frenzy.

- **Gold prices stable** at 1,255 yuan/gram, reflecting safe-haven demand amid global uncertainty. Multiple gold retailers reported unchanged prices ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1fRFhFU0J0WHpUcHRDYmJsRDlsRFpLSmp0RGIwT0gtOG45WmozLUV5TVUxd0h5ay1UM2txWlVhQndFREpSZVVBWEFxZm5CVUdicmxJWFZMdU5KY2g2TEE)).
- **June futures turnover surged over 50%** year-on-year, indicating heightened speculative interest across commodities and index futures ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE44ZVY2eXM3U1ZuVEw4c0sxSlM1d2p5ampCSU13RkxMNHVnaTNqU2UzMlE3MGNQN1Q3ZDdpS212aXhZT1h6a0RXa0dGU1RlNEJ1dEIzMlpXTVJuLW5kYjNMYkN3)).
- **Military-equipment stocks exploded**, with a 1,000-billion market cap leader hitting the daily limit in one minute. The sector saw eight stocks surge as retail money rushed in ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE83em1qVlFkUU9rTWxqMEVMdXZmODFMdmpTYUNUXzlwMUp3MHJyODh4RUFzOWRLRjlPNHFhdmlGZmJIYXRjdjFSQXdZYkpDZTlpZC15WlB3cUEtWVAxcjdPc2x3)).
- **A 5x semiconductor bull stock** is about to resume trading after announcing a semiconductor acquisition, drawing attention to the M&A theme in chips ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBvTjJGTlJVb2J5YnVnSFFvMmM4NHBxeWxtU3ZqRHJvSVNKUDBIWkNjbXo2YnZxalNybTIwVkJBU3o5MmZzenRISEJqeDdyZHlMc3BFMGM0dDJzbldJbWlvVFF3)).
- **Stock 000980 under investigation** for alleged information disclosure violations. The company has suffered seven consecutive years of losses totaling over 25 billion yuan, with a debt-to-asset ratio nearing 99% ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1OWnNXTXB6bkxJcnFnT0lmMzVoaGxmWjh5LUk5eF9kUjVoMUpaXzhoQkVhNFFzN0g0NUdXYk1tODlIU2ZPZy1zVV9IVTY0TWhZTUhyTFBZaGdXYVVVYU8wanN3)).

**Signal:** Retail sentiment remains hot, driven by military and semiconductor themes, but the investigation into a high-debt stock serves as a warning. Watch for increased volatility in small-cap names and the upcoming semiconductor M&A restart.

欧美.zh:
欧美今日聚焦灾害与冲突：西班牙山火致死12人，含多名外籍；美伊冲突短暂平息但特朗普强硬表态；科技界Meta、Apple与OpenAI之间法律战升级。

- [西班牙山火已致12死，含4名英国人，23人失踪](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 火灾蔓延至旅游区，当局称系近年最致命。
- [Meta撤回AI图像修改功能](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dy6e8klw0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 因用户滥用生成不当内容，反映AI产品上线风险管控缺失。
- [美伊谈判重启，特朗普威胁“摧毁”伊朗](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/11/iran-war-live-us-demands-iran-publicly-state-strait-of-hormuz-open-for-all?traffic_source=rss) 冲突暂停但互信脆弱，霍尔木兹海峡航运仍存变数。
- [苹果起诉OpenAI窃密](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8w379e091o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 指控其挖角员工并窃取硬件技术，科技巨头AI人才争夺白热化。
- [休斯顿ICE误杀平民，官方承认目标错误](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm2rm66xd17o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 凸显移民执法中程序漏洞和连带伤害。

**收束**：欧美社会在科技伦理、移民执法和地缘冲突中面临多重考验，后续需关注美伊谈判细节及Meta AI功能后续调整。
欧美.en:
The European and American desk covers the volatile U.S.-Iran situation, the tragic Spanish wildfire, and ongoing tech industry conflicts. The U.S. demands Iran pledge to stop shooting at ships in the Strait of Hormuz, while domestic incidents like an ICE shooting error and crypto billionaires' alternative governance schemes also surface.

- **U.S.-Iran**: Fighting appears to pause; VP Vance to join Oman talks. Trump threatens to 'decimate and destroy' all areas of Iran if he is assassinated. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/11/iran-war-live-us-demands-iran-publicly-state-strait-of-hormuz-open-for-all?traffic_source=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/10/g-s1-132943/up-first-newsletter-iran-us-tps-haitians-syrians-eac-gaza-israel-hamas))
- **Spain wildfire**: At least 12 dead, 23 missing, four Britons feared among victims. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1wyv383j2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Meta AI**: Pulls new AI image feature after backlash over altering Instagram content. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2dy6e8klw0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Apple vs OpenAI**: Lawsuit alleges trade secret theft; Apple says OpenAI's hardware business is 'rotten to its core.' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy8w379e091o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **ICE shooting**: Man fatally shot in Houston was not intended target, DHS says. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm2rm66xd17o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))

These stories highlight the intersection of geopolitical risk, climate disasters, and the accelerating AI arms race.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块以自然灾害和经济动态为主：超强台风“巴威”横扫日本南部，台湾紧急疏散；韩国美容旅游过热导致医生短缺；BTS深陷版权争议。

- [台风“巴威”袭击日本南部，台湾疏散数万人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQRXRvY3dvSWFhN0ctWDN4dmo3WGZKTVB2YkREdVVtUkZ4ckt0bklDQm5vcGp1clNQWGcycy02eGFQaGRSYTNEbktYQWp2MGZKNlptdDNfdmxkTFAzZ1VHWThSY1Zvd3Q0Z1lhY1ljdmNPc3pRdVFPVnhrbEt3enNGWUVRREM) 风暴宽达1000公里，菲律宾已15死，日本西南部岛屿进入最高警戒。
- [日本“交通空白”恐年损失10万亿日元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5YWE9KRnlqQ09RV3B5ZjRYSHhVdmdyNjdRcUc4Z2dOVXNKVWRYLXN0aWxLcHI5UzJuZkx5Mkd4em1YMkgwS29pV2kxZGJhSE9Rd0ZQLUo5Y1hZRmNOdlZuMEZQQnQ1eDNpczYyOFVtdU1LSUsxTVRUYw) 偏远地区交通服务萎缩，咨询报告警告经济后果。
- [韩国美容旅游热导致医生从医院外流](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNSkpKUE5VRWdhQXgwc1ZHb0xGd29kZkI2Rl9RZU5UWGMyZm5lYUFTc2cyWEtOREJHd0pfYVBXV2V0Ql9hVFRObTlUOVozV0xDNGRoMG1XREdBWFJiYmE3QWJZa1UyTi1JZVR3akR1N0tHeEJoeV9RRXFqeTlHMFJPZDlXamZrZ2V6VHl0b1lWalZlWWNtYl9YUVdzZHdzXzZRMWFyVmFsVXVyMkEtTmxGZHlWd1NpeHc) 整形外科医生涌向诊所，公立医院人手不足。
- [BTS歌曲《Swim》被指抄袭，Big Hit否认](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5McVdsM3lTQkRQZjFwY2xzcTJhMzExQmk2a3FxWDZwdWZpNlFubkFkcnE4UUxQcUFNQUNJakFaV0RtVXdrdmQ4bWRGZ0VpYm1BVDU0N0V0TQ) 粉丝和业界关注侵权诉讼走向。

**收束**：台风“巴威”的破坏力或叠加日本交通脆弱性，韩国医疗服务结构失衡值得持续观察。
日韩.en:
Japan and South Korea are bracing for Typhoon Bavi, which has already caused landslides in the Philippines. In South Korea, a beauty tourism boom is diverting doctors from hospital work, while the BTS copyright controversy and IU-Lee Jong-suk breakup dominate entertainment news.

- **Typhoon Bavi**: Lashes Japan's southern islands; Taiwan evacuates thousands. The storm is forecast to be one of the strongest in decades. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQRXRvY3dvSWFhN0ctWDN4dmo3WGZKTVB2YkREdVVtUkZ4ckt0bklDQm5vcGp1clNQWGcycy02eGFQaGRSYTNEbktYQWp2MGZKNlptdDNfdmxkTFAzZ1VHWThSY1Zvd3Q0Z1lhY1ljdmNPc3pRdVFPVnhrbEt3enNGWUVRREM))
- **SK hynix**: Raises $26.5bn in US listing, capitalizing on AI chip demand. ([Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/10/south-korea-chip-maker-sk-hynix-rides-ai-boom-raising-265bn-in-huge-us-listing))
- **Beauty tourism boom**: Doctors in South Korea leaving hospital work for lucrative cosmetic procedures. ([Nikkei Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNSkpKUE5VRWdhQXgwc1ZHb0xGd29kZkI2Rl9RZU5UWGMyZm5lYUFTc2cyWEtOREJHd0pfYVBXV2V0Ql9hVFRObTlUOVozV0xDNGRoMG1XREdBWFJiYmE3QWJZa1UyTi1JZVR3akR1N0tHeEJoeV9RRXFqeTlHMFJPZDlXamZrZ2V6VHl0b1lWalZlWWNtYl9YUVdzZHdzXzZRMWFyVmFsVXVyMkEtTmxGZHlWd1NpeHc))
- **BTS copyright dispute**: Big Hit Music denies infringement claims over 'Swim.' ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5McVdsM3lTQkRQZjFwY2xzcTJhMzExQmk2a3FxWDZwdWZpNlFubkFkcnE4UUxQcUFNQUNJakFaV0RtVXdrdmQ4bWRGZ0VpYm1BVDU0N0V0TQ))
- **IU and Lee Jong-suk**: Breakup after four years. ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBkSHVFNUc2QzdtSEtjUWtZMlVFOFJfUXZESHJXNG9HazhiS3hMTi1aem03RGdJUHpOVzhZZG1jOVdDUU5mb0h5VDdFNGROZExXd3l3UlpLdw))

Typhoon Bavi's landfall will be closely watched as it heads toward China, while Korea's economic and cultural dynamics remain active.

中国.zh:
中国板块官方外交与减贫成果占主导，同时有关于“医疗旅游”的公共讨论。习近平与金正恩互致贺电纪念中朝条约65周年，宁夏减贫现场会吸引50多国外宾。

- [习近平与金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9fWi12eFRTem54dGE2UkxZLUhQNkVQOTBraEtEUzgxT3lfZC1kVi04dkxsVnZnd290U05idDRRWkRMMlQxQnJXQk5fdDlQdEZZejdwaERjNXlqZGJmWHI1UHJpT0F2WWdoT1cySUpHVlQyRTNWSGJqU2t5T2ZlTE0) 蔡奇出席纪念招待会，显示中朝关系稳定。
- [50多国外宾齐聚宁夏探寻中国减贫密码](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBRLXFJdURXRXJsNkd0cThQd29fUUlscnJ3amZkcGJHNjVULS00YWpScVJoal85VHNOaTVDV0ZKcWN6N1lVVEVUWDUyOWlpTjZjLUFWZXkwdzdYRWdnMFQ5M3RsSExBSmNaekRKc19vU0ZlRkNIYjRpQld5QmNfOWc) 国际社会对中国扶贫模式兴趣浓厚。
- [“老外来中国看病旅游，该不该大力欢迎？”引发热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE0ydFp6dnJ6WUphQkcxRDBqaW1acXYwakR3MEw5bE9DNG5RdkdtZXhSSEw3M1lqS1J4Q2NidmF0aHFjMHA4UEZXNG9yVmFQMkZZVVBfc0lGZF9TLTRJT09vLU8xNHhuZw) 观察者网文章讨论医疗旅游利弊，反映社会对开放政策的复杂心态。
- [“古巴社会数字化转型”项目正式启动](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNY21ha1NZN283REVfbEZfcFVsek5ZUFFkalk2ZG93a0VLM1VIRzRuSTlYSGVpZjh6Zk1SR3k5TnJjekh0MW5qb2lFSzNaT1JnZTNlcnNUbklrZF9yVm1zaEVfY09RYjRuZWNNeW91M3l5S0lsZDhUU19zSlpJUWFFWW1iZzlFUQ) 中国参与古巴数字化建设，技术服务输出。

**收束**：中国外交与减贫议程稳步推进，但内部开放议题（如医疗旅游）的舆论分歧值得关注。
中国.en:
Chinese state media highlights diplomatic engagements with North Korea on the 65th anniversary of their friendship treaty, and China's role in UN peacebuilding. Domestically, stories include immersive ideological education and a conference on digital education.

- **Xi and Kim exchange messages**: On the 65th anniversary of the Sino-North Korean Friendship and Cooperation Treaty. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9fWi12eFRTem54dGE2UkxZLUhQNkVQOTBraEtEUzgxT3lfZC1kVi04dkxsVnZnd290U05idDRRWkRMMlQxQnJXQk5fdDlQdEZZejdwaERjNXlqZGJmWHI1UHJpT0F2WWdoT1cySUpHVlQyRTNWSGJqU2t5T2ZlTE0))
- **UN peacebuilding**: Chinese representative emphasizes development-first approach. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE8xOE1QTnoxb1Y4b0ZHOXpZRkpXbkRBT19vX3lVVjlCcVRTWEJhcGs5Zm1sWFRya2JPQjBvdHFkeWp1S0xldGVFX2RVeFRsNV9Zc3lKVUtiU1ZmaTRsVURfQ0pZQVI0MkZRVlRXVms1ajdwYnQwT0gwNW5lY2hvZ1U))
- **Poverty alleviation showcase**: 50 foreign guests visit Ningxia to learn China's poverty reduction model. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBRLXFJdURXRXJsNkd0cThQd29fUUlscnJ3amZkcGJHNjVULS00YWpScVJoal85VHNOaTVDV0ZKcWN6N1lVVEVUWDUyOWlpTjZjLUFWZXkwdzdYRWdnMFQ5M3RsSExBSmNaekRKc19vU0ZlRkNIYjRpQld5QmNfOWc))
- **WSIS 2026 awards**: Three Chinese projects win World Summit on the Information Society awards. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFA2TFNMdzZ2ZWhVNWFmdm42elpiREZuTTJ4VExIM1FZMXNhM3Mtd3htNldod0p4b2UtU1hZVm1Pa0c1ekRzTWtsSlJ2MUdaUUQ5OG96Vko5OE9KQmVLdmstRjlhbllsMlNYQXU1bVRsZ0lwYndGMFpZcXNNdXc5Zw))

China's official narrative remains focused on stability, development, and international cooperation, with little critical coverage of the typhoon or domestic issues.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日热点集中于娱乐与平台商业动态：迪丽热巴18岁素颜视频走红，引发暗黑美学讨论；知乎公布2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源称将加速AI商业化。

- [迪丽热巴18岁素颜艺考视频，暗黑美学风格引热议](https://news.google.) 视频在知乎、微博等平台传播，部分用户称呈现“暗黑美学”，讨论焦点为艺人早期形象与当今反差。
- [知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源：加速AI商业化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ) 财报显示广告收入承压，周源表示将依托AI大模型探索知识付费新场景。

**收束**：知乎用户对娱乐话题敏感度高，但平台自身面临增长困境，AI转型能否扭转颓势尚需观察。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu community dynamics reveal a mix of celebrity gossip and the platform's own financial struggles. A video of Dilireba's youthful appearance goes viral, while Zhihu reported a 23.6% revenue decline in 2025 and is accelerating AI commercialization.

- **Dilireba's viral video**: Her 18-year-old makeup-free audition clip sparks discussion of 'dark aesthetic.' ([Sina](https://news.google.))
- **Zhihu revenue decline**: 2025 revenue down 23.6%; CEO Zhou Yuan pushes AI commercialization. ([Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))

Zhihu's pivot to AI monetization will be key for its future, but user engagement remains driven by entertainment content.

国际安全.zh:
**概览**：全球军备竞赛与地区冲突交织，美国调整中东部署，欧洲寻求防空自主，亚太盟友加速军事投入。
- **[菲律宾欲将国防开支提至GDP 4%](https://news.google.)**：此举将使菲成为东南亚军费占比最高国家之一，直接回应南海紧张。
- **[美空军决定B-21采用双飞行员制](https://www.twz.com/air/usaf-decides-against-flying-b-21-raiders-with-just-one-pilot)**：正式确定下一代轰炸机机组规模，反映可靠性优先于自动化节省人力。
- **[土耳其S-400转售与F-35复购博弈](https://www.twz.com/air/russia-confirms-talks-with-turkey-over-fate-of-s-400s-amid-f-35-push)**：俄方已确认谈判，安卡拉在美俄之间走钢丝获得战略利益。
- **[乌克兰可获爱国者生产许可但耗时](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/07/10/ukraine-can-soon-build-its-own-patriots-but-it-could-take-years/)**：许可证仅向少数盟友发放，但形成产能需要数年，短期援助缺口仍大。
**收束**：各国正通过提高军费、技术自主和外交杠杆重塑安全承诺，国际安全体系进入“再武装”阶段。
国际安全.en:
Global security dynamics this week are dominated by NATO’s Ankara Summit fallout, a reshaping of missile defense architectures, and new air power movements tied to the Iran conflict. A U.S. F-16 pilot received a Distinguished Flying Cross for a Yemen mission, while F-22 Raptors redeployed from Israel to England, signaling a potential shift in CENTCOM posture. Meanwhile, France doubles down on hypersonic nuclear missiles for fighters, and the U.S. Air Force formally decided against single-pilot B-21 operations.

- NATO’s Ankara Summit declaration strengthens alliance posture, with implications for the Caucasus and European security ([finnchannel](https://news.google.)).
- F-22 Raptors arrive in England after deployment supporting Israel against Iran, part of a broader airpower retrograde from CENTCOM ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/f-22-raptors-arrive-in-england-after-deployment-to-israel-for-iran-war)).
- France is building a hypersonic nuclear missile for its fighter jets, prioritizing speed over stealth—a doctrinal bet with nuclear-strategic implications ([OkDiario](https://news.google.)).
- USAF confirms B-21 Raider will require two pilots, rejecting a single-pilot option as the bomber nears fielding next year ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/usaf-decides-against-flying-b-21-raiders-with-just-one-pilot)).
- Analysis shows Ukraine is reimagining strategic attack, adapting long-range strike concepts to a peer-level conflict ([Air & Space Forces Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNY1FyMTBVLUJOczhrLTgtUURKQnNEOVREeC1JZ3RYMm1CUEN2d2UwaTRjVGItNHVNV1NpajNYN1VzWklsU0tyQjFzMUZneUJ2VV9KM3IxaHBURHF2R0VhSzUyWlBhWVJ3TnRVVWNfXzhUOHN0UUdzX1Jzdk4xM2tPQ0V1QmhWUmdWR2hGbllhVVI)).

**Signal:** The convergence of NATO summit decisions, Turkish S-400 maneuvering, and U.S. air power redeployments suggests a recalibration of deterrence postures across Europe and the Middle East.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览**：乌克兰战争持续消耗，俄能源设施频遭袭；北约通过安卡拉峰会强化东翼，德涅斯特河沿岸风险浮现。
- **[中国再次呼吁乌克兰问题对话](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxPVEszclVKbWljdE5qQTdsZjdfN3ZoQURhY1VwQnd3RWtNa09oRXQ4QXduNmh3WV9vV1BCakNUQW96TC1qN2xidDMwaW51TElQZGFTNEt0NkZ5akt6aG1qZGdrZXJENEdrTTJDeVJvaFZzNjRfN3pSX2xGTzY0WGIyQXl3)**：虽立场未变，但在西方援乌升级背景下，中方的表态被视为平衡信号。
- **[乌克兰无人机击中南部俄炼油厂与亚速港](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE9HSDBKamNMZF81U0U5SkpTaXhiMVljeEU4d0NRRV9sMHZTZHN3eVpUTExfZWFTeHY3T3NnNjZMLXQwUFpnRUg3dGdCdzZUczdLX2pYbw)**：与俄方五死报道相互印证，显示乌军远程打击能力提升。
- **[美国联合沙特、卡塔尔等国应对伊朗冲突](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE0tR1Nsb1FLYlBzRXhaclp6b2lLc1hsU2FWUFQxTlZtTWZlN3N6VTJUSk83bEljWmFqcldRUXBPQzhqU0R2MXFCRktidlpia0JITFgtOVpsY2Q5eFFGUFZBd3FjYk5RTHdMaklyeTdB)**：中东联盟重组，霍尔木兹海峡紧张导致旅行警告升级。
- **[德涅斯特河沿岸冲突因乌克兰战争升温](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxQTFZ0Sm1oZXZIWFpWOXJkLWx6MlNHaEFlNWd6aDFZREN6TlJqYXUzUTktRGtmTlRmMTNHNUxNaV8xVTNTNUxzSExsY0FwYUhyM2hXY2RNYVBBNmZ1dHlIeGlXLWR1Qk5kQXd4YVJrUHE1dXR6Z1BwbUZ0enhaeHFtQXhmbnE2aUt4Y3lHdUpQdzVrWE56djVvUVBQVVBxaG1YdTBlbllLNnptMWVlY1B6WXYxR0lqU2Rtb1h0Y2QwN29OWHlpSjhTM0lfU00)**：俄罗斯“最长被遗忘的分离冲突”可能因乌克兰战事外溢而重新点燃。
**收束**：冲突长期化且外溢风险显著，欧洲安全架构面临冷战结束以来最严峻考验。
冲突局势.en:
Conflict dynamics remain intense across three primary fronts: Ukraine, Iran, and the lingering Transnistria flashpoint. Russian attacks killed five Ukrainians while Kyiv continues to strike Russian oil refineries and the Azov port. In the Gulf, the U.S. is teaming with Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, and Jordan amid escalating Iran conflict and airstrikes. A Chinese envoy called for restraint on Ukraine, while NATO’s summit asserts stronger deterrence in the Caucasus region.

- Russian attacks kill five in Ukraine as drone strikes hit southern Russian refineries and Azov port ([Al Jazeera](https://news.google.)).
- United States teams up with Gulf allies and Jordan as Iran tensions escalate, with travel warnings and Strait of Hormuz risks ([Travel And Tour World](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE0tR1Nsb1FLYlBzRXhaclp6b2lLc1hsU2FWUFQxTlZtTWZlN3N6VTJUSk83bEljWmFqcldRUXBPQzhqU0R2MXFCRktidlpia0JITFgtOVpsY2Q5eFFGUFZBd3FjYk5RTHdMaklyeTdB)).
- Chinese envoy calls for restraint and dialogue on Ukraine, signaling Beijing’s continued diplomatic distance from Western escalation ([China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxPVEszclVKbWljdE5qQTdsZjdfN3ZoQURhY1VwQnd3RWtNa09oRXQ4QXduNmh3WV9vV1BCakNUQW96TC1qN2xidDMwaW51TElQZGFTNEt0NkZ5akt6aG1qZGdrZXJENEdrTTJDeVJvaFZzNjRfN3pSX2xGTzY0WGIyQXl3)).
- Transnistria conflict heating up as the Ukraine war reignites Russia’s longest-forgotten separatist dispute ([New Eastern Europe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxQTFZ0Sm1oZXZIWFpWOXJkLWx6MlNHaEFlNWd6aDFZREN6TlJqYXUzUTktRGtmTlRmMTNHNUxNaV8xVTNTNUxzSExsY0FwYUhyM2hXY2RNYVBBNmZ1dHlIeGlXLWR1Qk5kQXd4YVJrUHE1dXR6Z1BwbUZ0enhaeHFtQXhmbnE2aUt4Y3lHdUpQdzVrWE56djVvUVBQVVBxaG1YdTBlbllLNnptMWVlY1B6WXYxR0lqU2Rtb1h0Y2QwN29OWHlpSjhTM0lfU00)).
- NATO’s Ankara Summit declaration signals stronger posture with implications for Caucasus and European security ([finnchannel](https://news.google.)).

**Signal:** The dual pressures of Iranian escalation and protracted war in Ukraine are forcing both NATO and non-NATO states to reassess their defensive and offensive postures, with ripple effects from the Black Sea to the Strait of Hormuz.

中国军情.zh:
**概览**：南海仲裁案十周年之际，中国密集发声否定裁决，同时海警展示存在；台海议题持续受美方介入。
- **[中方重申南海仲裁案“非法无效”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE5lWHdKWi1NS0VPbW9aVS1GNUJ3dzdXTUdlcWdJU3RoNWgtVzVHR3dVS0JIbWJSNEJWSk9ETERzZzRYajJ2RkpseUR5UkxWY1B6QVM0WDBmcEowOGlkeW11RXRWVFNzZ3pyaUNuOGpPYkd5bGxwcnc)**：外交部、中青网、搜狐等多家官媒同步发声，形成舆论集中回应。
- **[菲律宾“被整破防”舆情](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE1GcWQzeWhva3NrWE4xaE1rdFZpSmREZkJ4N09ydEJZLW82YWs1MTlkQ3F4YnBXTUtFaVJZTmZhQ1JHRzBsQjgwQk1FYVI4TTJJWHp2NlJ2cW1lUFROR2RnNWZfMzUzNlVyLVlGNU1WM1NfN2FC)**：国内媒体以轻松标题报道菲方焦虑，暗示中国海警与外交施压见效。
- **[美众院中国问题委员会主席盼特朗普维持台海现状](https://news.google.)**：显示美国行政与立法部门在台湾问题上的持续介入。
- **[长平观察：习近平还能攻打台湾吗？](https://news.google.)**：德媒分析文章探讨中国对台动武的可能性与制约因素，反映国际学界持续关注。
**收束**：南海与台海议题持续升温，中国以法律与舆论双重手段巩固主权叙事，但外部压力不减。
中国军情.en:
China’s military and diplomatic apparatus is heavily focused on the 10-year anniversary of the “South China Sea Arbitration Case,” with state media publishing coordinated rebuttals and the Foreign Ministry reiterating non-recognition of the ruling. Philippine Defense Secretary Teodoro’s call for 4% GDP defense spending is met with sharp Chinese-language commentary framing Manila as “broken” under pressure. Meanwhile, the U.S. House China Select Committee Chair urged the Trump administration to maintain a firm stance on Taiwan’s status quo, and a DW analysis questioned whether Xi Jinping can still attack Taiwan.

- Chinese media launches intensive campaign against the “illegal” 2016 arbitration award, labeling it a “absurd farce” 10 years on ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNMk9vTVlYbmQ5ODUtSjV4NkFvbUdJeGx1anIzSFN3QUVreWpyakxYdzU4WUJuNi1UVDRIUC1SVndWZDE4NWRXTGlWcVJwaDBpbk5rZHB2cUtTZ0MxaS11MFNEeW1JamY3RnNUcUM0RDE5bXh0R2s3eFpCeUhxVm9iS09OQmtJTmFM)).
- Philippine Defense Secretary Teodoro pushes 4% GDP defense spending; Chinese outlet “Sina” reports Manila is “broken” (“被整破防了”) amid escalating disputes ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE1GcWQzeWhva3NrWE4xaE1rdFZpSmREZkJ4N09ydEJZLW82YWs1MTlkQ3F4YnBXTUtFaVJZTmZhQ1JHRzBsQjgwQk1FYVI4TTJJWHp2NlJ2cW1lUFROR2RnNWZfMzUzNlVyLVlGNU1WM1NfN2FC)).
- U.S. House China Committee Chair urges President Trump to maintain cross-strait status quo, stressing the importance of a “firm stance” ([VOA](https://news.google.)).
- DW’s “Changping Observers” column questions whether Xi Jinping can still launch an attack on Taiwan, citing internal and external constraints ([DW](https://news.google.)).
- China Coast Guard South China Sea Bureau holds an open day event featuring a ship tour, aiming to project transparency and presence ([Guangzhou Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQRm1hdEdpa2JTZXhjcC1ZZHh5RmlndkNubFZ6UTUxeE9KOUNuazQ0NFo1a3doeUpwbzhsWC1kZ2VQMkFGLTlhQ3NsSFNmYXJwNlg1dWxuS0FfYlVib0N4cENTaXl0VmtscnFlc3QyZkFvU2s1UEFVcF9HV0xCUUxaTzk2aF9STjFJZnc)).

**Signal:** Beijing is using the arbitration anniversary to reinforce its maritime claims narrative, but the Philippine budget hike indicates Manila is preparing for a long-term confrontation rather than backing down.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览**：印太海上力量动态活跃，美国探索海外造船降低成本，欧盟与德国聚焦反高超音速与激光武器。
- **[霍尔木兹海峡6月交通量较5月翻倍但仍低迷](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)**：Lloyd‘s List数据显示从233次升至576次，但同比去年6月3131次暴跌，航运业仍在规避风险。
- **[RIMPAC 2026进入实弹阶段](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-10-2026)**：加拿大护卫舰率先开火，无人水面舰艇参演，体现美盟无人化作战趋势。
- **[美海军正式调研韩国船厂造舰](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-rfi-south-korea-shipbuilding-destroyers/)**：两份RFI针对驱逐舰和油船，若突破将重塑全球海军造船产业链。
- **[德国海军2029年部署高能激光武器](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-navy-to-deploy-new-mbda-and-rheinmetall-laser-weapon-by-2029/)**：ARGE HEL集团签合同，目标拦截无人机与导弹。
- **[科威特首次采购Rheinmetall MASS诱饵系统](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/kuwait-procures-rheinmetalls-mass-decoy-launchers-for-the-first-time/)**：8艘舰艇装备软杀伤系统，反映海湾国家加强舰艇自卫。
**收束**：海军装备正朝着无人化、定向能、低成本化方向演进，同时美国为维持舰队规模急于拓宽建造来源。
海军与印太.en:
The Indo-Pacific naval landscape is undergoing significant changes, with the U.S. Navy considering South Korean construction of destroyers and tankers—a historic policy shift. The German Navy is investing in laser weapons for ships by 2029, while the EU funds a hypersonic interceptor project. Strait of Hormuz traffic shows a fragile recovery amid ongoing Iranian attacks, and RIMPAC 2026 enters live-fire phase. Kuwait also acquires Rheinmetall decoy launchers for its fleet.

- U.S. Navy issues RFIs to South Korean shipbuilders for DDG(X) destroyers and fleet tankers, potentially ending the 80-year ban on foreign warship construction ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-rfi-south-korea-shipbuilding-destroyers/)).
- German Navy signs contract for high-energy laser weapon development with MBDA and Rheinmetall, aiming for operational deployment by 2029 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-navy-to-deploy-new-mbda-and-rheinmetall-laser-weapon-by-2029/)).
- EU signs grant for MBDA-led HYDIS hypersonic interceptor project, completing concept phase for the AQUILA interceptor ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/eu-signs-grant-for-mbda-led-hydis-hypersonic-interceptor-project/)).
- Strait of Hormuz traffic more than doubled from May to June (233 to 576 transits) but remains far below the June 2025 baseline of 3,131, illustrating persistent risk ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)).
- RIMPAC 2026 at-sea phase begins with live-fire drills; Royal Canadian Navy frigate HMCS Ottawa participates ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-10-2026)).
- Kuwait procures Rheinmetall MASS decoy launchers for eight vessels, marking first Kuwaiti acquisition of the system ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/kuwait-procures-rheinmetalls-mass-decoy-launchers-for-the-first-time)).

**Signal:** The U.S. Navy’s openness to South Korean shipbuilding could catalyze a major realignment in global naval construction, while European nations accelerate directed-energy and hypersonic defense programs in response to evolving threats.

AI.zh:
今日AI赛道充满动荡：价格战因Meta大举投入而进一步白热化，但安全与隐私争议同样突出。OpenAI安全主管离职、苹果指控其窃取商业秘密，以及Meta撤回争议性AI图像功能，都指向行业正经历快速扩张伴随的治理裂痕。

- AI价格战信号明确，Meta通过巨额资本支出推动模型前沿，同时市场出现“赢家与输家”分化——[AI Price War Intensifies As Meta Pushes Frontier With Massive Spending](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE4ybnctUzBUcktITUxid1NZQTQ2dFlPOHp6dmZfNC1QeEIyS3FTRVpRSngySzlSeGRNRVVZTmdNNXk3TXpHUWRvclJoQU01VXFBM0RKaGNpNFBVVmRXdkpPR0Z3aFNBUktJZjAxWkh2M3o)。
- OpenAI安全负责人Johannes Heidecke离职，公司试图将安全团队更深嵌入研发——[OpenAI’s Head of Safety Is Leaving the Company](https://www.wired.com/story/openai-head-of-safety-leaving/)。
- Meta的Instagram AI图像生成功能（Muse Image）因允许用户生成任何公共账号的AI图像而引发全球反弹，已下线——[Meta deactivates feature that let you generate AI images of any public Instagram account](https://www.engadget.com/2212843/meta-deactivates-muse-image-public-instagram-post-ai-images/)。
- 苹果在BBC报道中起诉OpenAI及其员工窃取商业机密，反映大型科技公司间AI人才与数据争夺升级——[Apple sues OpenAI, its employees claiming theft of trade secrets](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy8w379e091o)。
- 大型科技公司债务总额翻倍至3500亿美元，用于AI基础设施投入——[Big Tech Doubles Debt Load to $350B in AI Spending Spree](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-10/big-tech-doubles-debt-load-to-350-billion-in-ai-spending-spree)。

短期来看，安全与法律风险可能抑制部分AI应用的激进部署，但巨额资本支出意味着竞争不会降温。
AI.en:
The AI sector saw a cascade of major events: Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI alleging trade secret theft, Meta deactivated its controversial Instagram AI feature that could generate images of any public account following global backlash, and OpenAI’s head of safety, Johannes Heidecke, left the company amid a reorganization. Meanwhile, Big Tech’s combined debt has doubled to $350 billion, with Meta aggressively spending on AI infrastructure, triggering a price war. The community is also buzzing about practical local AI setups and a new tool for per-call billing receipts.

- [Apple sues OpenAI, its employees claiming theft of trade secrets](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy8w379e091o)
- [Meta removes controversial AI feature on Instagram after backlash](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/meta-removes-controversial-ai-feature-on-instagram-after-backlash/)
- [OpenAI Safety Head Heidecke to Leave Firm After Reshuffle](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-11/openai-safety-head-heidecke-to-leave-firm-after-reshuffle-wired)
- [Big Tech Doubles Debt Load to $350B in AI Spending Spree](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-10/big-tech-doubles-debt-load-to-350-billion-in-ai-spending-spree)
- [AI Price War Intensifies As Meta Pushes Frontier With Massive Spending](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE4ybnctUzBUcktITUxid1NZQTQ2dFlPOHp6dmZfNC1QeEIyS3FTRVpRSngySzlSeGRNRVVZTmdNNXk3TXpHUWRvclJoQU01VXFBM0RKaGNpNFBVVmRXdkpPR0Z3aFNBUktJZjAxWkh2M3o)

The AI industry is entering a period of intense competition and regulatory pushback, with lawsuits and public trust issues challenging the rapid deployment of generative AI.

汽车.zh:
中国电动车在全球市场的主导地位进一步巩固，澳大利亚7月销量前七名全部中资或中国制造；小米、比亚迪等推出新品，特斯拉则面临政策与区域市场挑战。

- 澳大利亚7月电动车销量创历史新高，前七款车均来自中国品牌或中国工厂，包括上海产特斯拉Model Y——[Australia’s 7 best-selling EVs are now all Chinese](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/australia-top-7-evs-all-chinese/)。
- 小米发布SkyNomad N90增程式SUV，综合续航超1500公里，定价与理想L9、问界M9竞争，标志着小米汽车产品线向上延伸——[Xiaomi reveals SkyNomad N90: a living room on wheels](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/xiaomi-skynomad-n90-erev-suv/)。
- NHTSA局长表示将“绝对”考虑取消无人驾驶汽车的转向盘强制规定，为Waymo等车队大规模部署开路——[NHTSA Chief Says Agency Will 'Absolutely' Consider Dropping Steering Wheel Rule for Driverless Cars](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9sREo5Wl9qWlRiMGNzLTVUeF9KM3FId1p0c2drUDl0QkdhREdtbDFUS0t2ams5d0xVYTZ1dU9rRWlrcno1ZzA1RWpjT0dQQVlYcG1uMFZSOHRFSHk4RXYtcTZTOWIwVTJSVGdmeWVVWXQ0QQ)。
- 纽约/新泽西的机器人出租车法案排除特斯拉，因其自动驾驶安全记录不佳——[Tesla Gets Written Out of New Jersey's Robotaxi Bill](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE54Z1lZbGhLczVWTlg2V2xkR3laOC1BWHFaaVA3dlVTNGJkODFqbDJnTjY1QlBmTUhHWWZLcEhOU0k3Vk5iSjNuUHlDY0JSM192RW1kXzZCNklaQ1ZCVVNndjloZDdCbDZnb3c)。
- UNIGRID的钠离子家用电池首次在欧洲部署，未来瞄准美国市场，挑战锂离子储能统治地位——[UNIGRID’s sodium-ion home battery debuts in Europe, US is next](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/unigrid-sodium-ion-home-battery-debuts-in-europe-us/)。

中国EV攻势不减，但美国政策（如关税、法案排他）可能抑制中国品牌直接进入市场；钠离子电池商业化信号值得关注。
汽车.en:
The EV market is seeing dramatic shifts: Xiaomi entered the extended-range EV segment with the SkyNomad N90 SUV boasting a 932-mile combined range, while BYD updated its low-cost Seagull EV with a longer body. In the US, Tesla faces regulatory hurdles—New Jersey’s robotaxi bill explicitly excludes Tesla, and the NHTSA is considering dropping the steering wheel requirement for driverless cars. Australia’s EV sales data shows all top seven sellers are Chinese-made, including Tesla’s Model Y built in Shanghai.

- [Xiaomi reveals SkyNomad N90: a living room on wheels](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/xiaomi-skynomad-n90-erev-suv/)
- [BYD’s $10,000 Seagull EV revealed with a longer body and more upgrades](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/byds-10k-seagull-ev-revealed-longer-body-more-upgrades/)
- [Tesla Gets Written Out of New Jersey's Robotaxi Bill](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE54Z1lZbGhLczVWTlg2V2xkR3laOC1BWHFaaVA3dlVTNGJkODFqbDJnTjY1QlBmTUhHWWZLcEhOU0k3Vk5iSjNuUHlDY0JSM192RW1kXzZCNklaQ1ZCVVNndjloZDdCbDZnb3c)
- [Australia’s 7 best-selling EVs are now all Chinese — even Tesla’s](https://electrek.co/2026/07/10/australia-top-7-evs-all-chinese/)
- [NHTSA Chief Says Agency Will 'Absolutely' Consider Dropping Steering Wheel Rule for Driverless Cars](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9sREo5Wl9qWlRiMGNzLTVUeF9KM3FId1p0c2drUDl0QkdhREdtbDFUS0t2ams5d0xVYTZ1dU9rRWlrcno1ZzA1RWpjT0dQQVlYcG1uMFZSOHRFSHk4RXYtcTZTOWIwVTJSVGdmeWVVWXQ0QQ)

The EV landscape is rapidly realigning, with Chinese brands and new entrants challenging legacy automakers, while US regulatory battles could reshape autonomous driving policy.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品领域今日聚焦网络安全、监管执法与前沿技术进展。CISA自身安全疏漏、FCC打击DJI、量子纠错取得突破，以及消费者保护新规成为亮点。

- 美国CISA在应对GitGuardian发现的安全事件时，才意识到需要构建事件响应手册，凸显联邦机构网安狼狈——[US cybersecurity agency CISA had to build its incident playbook during the incident](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/us-cyber-agency-cisa-had-to-build-its-incident-playbook-during-the-incident-agency-reveals/)。
- FCC对DJI涉嫌利用空壳公司Xtra、Skyrover等绕过美国无人机禁令采取行动，将撤销相关认证——[The FCC is cracking down on DJI tech that dodged the foreign drone ban](https://www.theverge.com/policy/964342/fcc-crack-down-dji-front-companies-xtra-skyrover-sgs-lab)。
- 量子计算领域：新的纠错方法利用强化学习持续校准处理器，有望解决量子计算工程化最头疼的稳定性问题——[Quantum error correction can constantly recalibrate a processor](https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/07/quantum-error-correction-can-constantly-recalibrate-a-processor/)。
- 纽约市推出“点击即取消”规则，要求订阅服务必须提供与订阅同等便利的取消方式，违反者面临处罚——[Mamdani announces new Click-to-Cancel rule for New York City](https://www.engadget.com/2212741/mamdani-announces-new-click-to-cancel-rule-for-new-york-city/)。
- 微软碳排放量跳升25%，数据中心扩张是主因——[Microsoft Reports a Massive 25 Percent Jump in Emissions](https://www.wired.com/story/microsoft-25-percent-jump-in-carbon-emissions/)。

监管与创新的拉扯仍在持续，联邦机构的自身安全漏洞令人担忧，量子计算的纠错进展则提供了技术乐观信号。
科技产品.en:
A wave of tech policy and ethics stories: StubHub’s CEO is accused of funding scalpers on his own platform, the US cybersecurity agency CISA built its incident playbook mid-crisis, and Bill Gates’ daughter’s startup Phia faces “cookie stuffing” allegations. The FCC is cracking down on DJI’s front companies that circumvent the US drone ban, and Microsoft reported a 25% jump in emissions driven by data centers. Meanwhile, Bluesky appointed a permanent CEO, and China successfully recovered its first reusable rocket.

- [StubHub CEO is helping fund mass scalpers on his own platform](https://www.engadget.com/2212625/stubhub-ceo-is-helping-fund-mass-scalpers-on-his-own-platform/)
- [US cybersecurity agency CISA had to build its incident playbook during the incident](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/us-cyber-agency-cisa-had-to-build-its-incident-playbook-during-the-incident-agency-reveals/)
- [Phia accused of ‘cookie stuffing’](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/phia-accused-of-cookie-stuffing-taking-affiliate-credit-on-purchases-it-didnt-earn/)
- [The FCC is cracking down on DJI tech that dodged the foreign drone ban](https://www.theverge.com/policy/964342/fcc-crack-down-dji-front-companies-xtra-skyrover-sgs-lab)
- [Microsoft Reports a Massive 25 Percent Jump in Emissions](https://www.wired.com/story/microsoft-25-percent-jump-in-carbon-emissions/)

Tech policy and corporate ethics are under increasing scrutiny, with regulatory bodies moving to close loopholes and hold companies accountable.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
Hacker News社区今天讨论涵盖宏大历史、基础物理、政策变革与前沿技术。热门贴包括人类战争互动地图、爱因斯坦相对论在新材料中的验证，以及SpaceX的卫星规模扩张。

- “War Atlas”项目以互动地图可视化人类历史中每一场命名战争，获128点赞和58评论——[War Atlas: An interactive cartography of every named war in human history](https://waratlas.org/)。
- 布朗大学研究表明爱因斯坦相对论在重元素化学键中起决定性作用，挑战传统化学理论——[Einstein's relativity rules chemical bonds in heavy elements, new research shows](https://www.brown.edu/news/2026-07-09/chemical-bonds-relativity)。
- 纽约市禁止欺骗性订阅行为的规定在社区引发广泛讨论（463点赞、231评论），技术宅关注实现细节——[New York City to ban deceptive subscription practices](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/10/new-york-city-deceptive-subscriptions-ban)。
- SpaceX计划再发射10万颗Starlink卫星以实现100倍带宽，但轨道碎片和光污染忧虑不散——[SpaceX wants to launch 100k more Starlink satellites for 100x the bandwidth](https://www.zdnet.com/home-and-office/networking/spacex-wants-to-launch-100000-more-starlink-satellites/)。
- 蜗牛牙齿超越蜘蛛丝成为自然界最强材料（2015年文章重新浮出水面），获166点赞——[Snails' teeth beats spider silk as nature's strongest material (2015)](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/spider-silk-loses-top-spot-natures-strongest-material-snails-teeth-180954346/)。

社区讨论显示出对系统性知识（战争、物理）、政策影响（订阅规则）以及未来技术风险（星链）的深度兴趣，且经典论文重提也引发怀旧与科普。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News front page is dominated by a giant interactive map of every named war in history (War Atlas), a project that beat Cloudflare’s bot detection with an open-source stealth browser, and new research showing Einstein’s relativity rules chemical bonds in heavy elements. A detailed analysis on residential proxies and web scraping drew massive engagement, as did news of New York City banning deceptive subscription practices. SpaceX’s plan to launch 100,000 more Starlink satellites for 100x bandwidth sparked a fiery debate with over 350 comments.

- [War Atlas: An interactive cartography of every named war in human history](https://waratlas.org/)
- [Show HN: We beat Cloudflare's bot detection (open-source stealth browser)](https://tilion.dev/blog/cloudflare-blocks-agents)
- [Einstein's relativity rules chemical bonds in heavy elements](https://www.brown.edu/news/2026-07-09/chemical-bonds-relativity)
- [New York City to ban deceptive subscription practices](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/10/new-york-city-deceptive-subscriptions-ban)
- [SpaceX wants to launch 100k more Starlink satellites for 100x the bandwidth](https://www.zdnet.com/home-and-office/networking/spacex-wants-to-launch-100000-more-starlink-satellites/)

Open-source and community-driven projects continue to push boundaries, while debates over surveillance, space infrastructure, and scientific discovery remain vibrant.

足球.zh:
**⚽ 足球专栏**

世界杯四强全部产生：西班牙依靠梅里诺第88分钟绝杀2‑1淘汰比利时（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/videos/cd0m9e88g0vo)），英格兰则在四分之一决赛前获得全员健康利好，赖斯、格希、詹姆斯均参加合练（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o)）。图赫尔公开抱怨夸安萨红牌追加停赛未获解释（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562219/thomas-tuchel-reveals-england-still-yet-to-receive-explanation-over-jarell-quansahs-upgraded-two-game-suspension-after-mexico-red-card)），挪威主帅则示弱称英格兰是晋级大热门（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cq61n2gqqv0o)）。曼联求购亚特兰大中场埃德森的交易因故存疑（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c9d2z59596eo)），而AC米兰已官宣签下拉齐奥中卫吉拉，转会费3000万欧元（[虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE96ZjZpdHZPcXFsVGVIOS1OanhIUDNENzF5cTNteWtQMzhKakFOUW0xa1JJenRoRDBLdXcyU0Izb0haMXAxM0ozemM5UkVSLVlBM2x6LTMyQQ)）。比利时黄金一代在拉门斯失误后正式落幕（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy107g38eo)）。梅里诺从重伤中崛起的故事感人至深（[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562417/mikel-merino-arsenal-midfielder-proving-spains-world-cup-hero-after-overcoming-injury-that-left-him-in-mobility-scooter)）。欧洲转会窗后续变动将影响各队下赛季布局。
足球.en:
World Cup action dominates football news. Spain's dramatic 2-1 win over Belgium knocked out a golden generation and set up a semi-final with France. England's squad trains without injury worries ahead of their quarter-final vs Norway, despite a lingering dispute over Jarell Quansah's suspension. Meanwhile, Manchester United's pursuit of Atalanta's Ederson hits a snag.
- **Spain into semis**: Mikel Merino's late winner ends Belgium's campaign; Lamine Yamal yet to ignite. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvg50pvejzdo) | [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/videos/cd0m9e88g0vo)
- **Belgium's golden generation ends**: Goalkeeper error by Senne Lammens proves costly. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gy107g38eo)
- **England team news**: Guehi, Rice, James train ahead of Norway; Tuchel unhappy with Quansah's unexplained two-match ban. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3eyqdwq392o) | [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562219/thomas-tuchel-reveals-england-still-yet-to-receive-explanation-over-jarell-quansahs-upgraded-two-game-suspension-after-mexico-red-card)
- **Transfer talk**: Man Utd's £35m Ederson deal in doubt. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c9d2z59596eo)
- **Merino's story**: From mobility scooter to World Cup hero in six months. [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13562417/mikel-merino-arsenal-midfielder-proving-spains-world-cup-hero-after-overcoming-injury-that-left-him-in-mobility-scooter)

The football world now turns to England vs Norway and the semi-final lineup.

篮球.zh:
**🏀 篮球专栏**

中国裁判张潇在NBA夏季联赛执裁焦点战，这是中国篮球裁判首次在夏联舞台亮相，体现了中国篮球人才“走出去”的多元化（[球迷屋](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE5zQXU5Q29GNUFnMWJfcUJlV253c2tMcDd5YlR6QTBVQkpUUTVFUXNyTjZYM29rS3ZUVjJ3eWVGMGVCbG02RWluZE1DeFh5dzc0aTUweg)）。CBA方面，青岛国信海天俱乐部获评“优秀接待赛区”和“优秀场馆”双荣誉（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNUFl1Rm4zT2RiY3NIV1B6UUVfbkxQTERNSGVDT0JVcDdvNG5nYTJTVkJCRlZiZVRkUmRxR1JRbUVkX3RXaUI5TVVGdWV0cVQ4VHc5ZndMbGpIWVZqZlFRc3RYY1Mxa0UzS1R0dWdTS2JVTmVkTEM0UGl4WFd1S0xnUy1ISUo)）。另外，前NBA球员怀特塞德违规使用的禁药“氧雄龙”与“氯米芬”成分被科普分析（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQTUZEazZjVGpqeGRwYnc2Wi1FT2JzRVhLWElsc2x1WXJ1WDE1eHhTUDd2U0llU2MtVkpxdGtkLVBTQUEyRk5vanVqdV9sWVg0dDRuSTRfYUtmSFh6c3FDYlp0VERQQnlMTjVRMklqS2l3dF9xS2tsX1VkNkEtLU1aSUdBMmw)）。官方免费观赛渠道汇总也引发关注（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFB1NG4tUXJneDJvd25vU2k3R0ZjUlYwRnEtdFRKLXNGQUVjdWpGUnY1dEo2bXNOR1NsR1lVNE5EMHd4TXE2bV85ejJhbjVGaEsxcFowSHRCWDJ5dlpubW0tQ1lxekdRenZ3dTBJaTJPZy1kdzVEZTNN)）。从张潇的突破到CBA组织认可，中国篮球在裁判培养和联赛运营上持续进步。怀特塞德的禁药事件也提醒联盟需加强反兴奋剂教育。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball refereeing gains international spotlight as Zhang Xiao officiates a marquee NBA Summer League game. Domestically, Qingdao Guoxin Haitian Basketball Club earns 'Excellent Host City' and 'Excellent Venue' honors. Analysis emerges on the banned substances oxandrolone and clomiphene in relation to a player known as 'White Side'.
- **Chinese referee at NBA Summer League**: Zhang Xiao officiates a key game, highlighting China's growing referee pipeline. [球迷屋](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE5zQXU5Q29GNUFnMWJfcUJlV253c2tMcDd5YlR6QTBVQkpUUTVFUXNyTjZYM29rS3ZUVjJ3eWVGMGVCbG02RWluZE1DeFh5dzc0aTUweg)
- **Qingdao club awards**: Recognized for excellence in hosting and facilities. [Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxNUFl1Rm4zT2RiY3NIV1B6UUVfbkxQTERNSGVDT0JVcDdvNG5nYTJTVkJCRlZiZVRkUmRxR1JRbUVkX3RXaUI5TVVGdWV0cVQ4VHc5ZndMbGpIWVZqZlFRc3RYY1Mxa0UzS1R0dWdTS2JVTmVkTEM0UGl4WFd1S0xnUy1ISUo)
- **Doping analysis**: Deep dive into oxandrolone and clomiphene use by 'White Side'. [Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQTUZEazZjVGpqeGRwYnc2Wi1FT2JzRVhLWElsc2x1WXJ1WDE1eHhTUDd2U0llU2MtVkpxdGtkLVBTQUEyRk5vanVqdV9sWVg0dDRuSTRfYUtmSFh6c3FDYlp0VERQQnlMTjVRMklqS2l3dF9xS2tsX1VkNkEtLU1aSUdBMmw)
 
The basketball community continues to watch Chinese officiating progress and offseason league recognitions.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
**🐯 虎扑社区动态**

昨夜今晨虎扑热议话题横跨世界杯、转会、电竞、甚至武术。世界杯焦点：比利时被西班牙淘汰后，德布劳内谈手术回归与未来（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNZ3ZqQlcwUmhkODBpMzhqZW5HdHQ1SkgxQWtVZnduQ1V6MEtCU0pNNDNmSVRJMGtZVFBHT2otWUljb01oZGZWOXlnazVDdEgzR19PdTVpRDYyaVhrWVYwWk5uQUIzbUZZMC15ZW0yUFgtejVsZHBja3hUV1Z1Yk9rZThQY016ekt4MEVhbEpGQXBWQQ)）；赖斯青训秘辛曝光，每周三次“魔鬼训练”引阿森纳专区讨论（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNcXo3NWR6OHlBRnZFQWpOTGRydDFaZWV6S0N6dFgyUG1ocWl4N0pON2RTT1RmM3BOYVBoQVhyT0gxdlFHR3FHOFJTclI2NlJXN29femJZWHBXZDctdzhlb0pVS0RaX1M3UkpHUzhuNnlfMVBCTUNnUjdPOUVVRFAxeHJlVXljeWROYzh0SnR0ZzVmNUVSbTZF)）。转会市场：AC米兰官宣吉拉3000万加盟，皇马获二转分成成为热议（[腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE96ZjZpdHZPcXFsVGVIOS1OanhIUDNENzF5cTNteWtQMzhKakFOUW0xa1JJenRoRDBLdXcyU0Izb0haMXAxM0ozemM5UkVSLVlBM2x6LTMyQQ)）。NBA方面，怀特3年7400万续约后表态“保持本心”获得凯尔特人球迷点赞（[腾讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1yRzJuekNKN21uWjRqbDMwQzdpeHg4bmlUV0RvUHdvbWRzcGdtU3IwN0pNMkdCR1Nzck4tZVZEaDNQa0g4QU1uQlJkcWRCMktPNEVEZzlFcw)）。此外，CS:GO战队FaZe在BO3中13‑2碾压BB，电竞板块热度不减；甚至有网友分享“虎扑进身”武术教学（[网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE9YbFM0QkY0MnA3d0JuQ2Zfblkwb2ZpdVBSRVdlVnVLMllucGJBSjhSYTBVVWJ2VkpVcHBiV1Nram9JaWN4MmdzSDgtZWdvaUdXa2FWVA)）。虎扑作为国内最大体育社区，世界杯期间流量激增，跨项目讨论氛围浓厚，但部分内容（如武术教学）略显突兀，凸显社区标签管理的挑战。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Hupu community discussions focus heavily on World Cup aftermath, with Belgium's exit and De Bruyne's future dominating. Transfer news includes AC Milan signing Gila from Lazio for €30m. In the NBA, Derrick White's 3-year, $74M extension draws fan reactions. A nostalgic piece on Cristiano Ronaldo's 2022 World Cup near-miss also surfaces.
- **Belgium exit & De Bruyne**: 1-2 loss to Spain; De Bruyne discusses return from surgery and future. [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNZ3ZqQlcwUmhkODBpMzhqZW5HdHQ1SkgxQWtVZnduQ1V6MEtCU0pNNDNmSVRJMGtZVFBHT2otWUljb01oZGZWOXlnazVDdEgzR19PdTVpRDYyaVhrWVYwWk5uQUIzbUZZMC15ZW0yUFgtejVsZHBja3hUV1Z1Yk9rZThQY016ekt4MEVhbEpGQXBWQQ)
- **AC Milan transfer**: Gila from Lazio for €30m, with Real Madrid retaining 15% sell-on clause. [腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE96ZjZpdHZPcXFsVGVIOS1OanhIUDNENzF5cTNteWtQMzhKakFOUW0xa1JJenRoRDBLdXcyU0Izb0haMXAxM0ozemM5UkVSLVlBM2x6LTMyQQ)
- **Derrick White extension**: 3 years, $74M; White says 'stay true and keep working'. [腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1yRzJuekNKN21uWjRqbDMwQzdpeHg4bmlUV0RvUHdvbWRzcGdtU3IwN0pNMkdCR1Nzck4tZVZEaDNQa0g4QU1uQlJkcWRCMktPNEVEZzlFcw)
- **Ronaldo reflection**: Former manager Santos laments Ronaldo never winning the World Cup; says 2022 team was confident. [腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFAwREN5NGJlVXU4TmRKZ2k1M2c0UjV5UTdhOExuSGdzMDFUbHVpUG9QRHdmWTVMY1VTem85RXdfc0laNk5lbFFIWklBVGRrNzUzVk10NE5zaw)
 
Hupu users are most engaged with World Cup narratives and high-profile transfer rumors.

欧美.zh:
今日欧美娱乐圈涌动三股暗流：AI伦理争议、老将离世、商业并购提速。诺兰在最新访谈中高度评价Z世代影人对生成式AI的“彻底拒绝”，认为这项技术“撞上了最糟糕的时机”[Christopher Nolan Praises Gen Z Filmmakers](https://deadline.com/2026/07/christopher-nolan-praises-gen-z-utterly-rejecting-ai-1236979769/)；与此同时，Meta迫于CAA和SAG-AFTRA的强烈反对，刚刚上线几天的Muse AI图像生成器即遭撤下，承认“跑偏了”[Zucked Up! Meta Disables AI Image Generator](https://deadline.com/2026/07/meta-disables-new-ai-image-generator-zuckerberg-1236979706/)。
- [Barbara Ling, Oscar-Winning Production Designer, Dies at 73](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/barbara-ling-dead-once-upon-time-hollywood-production-designer-1236644433/) 这位赋予《好莱坞往事》视觉灵魂的女性美术指导，追悼声中留下了《大门》《油炸绿番茄》等经典。
- [Don Iwerks, Disney Camera Pioneer, Dies at 96](https://deadline.com/2026/07/don-iwerks-dead-disney-exec-1236979775/) 米老鼠联合创造者之子、迪士尼传奇，其投影与3D技术革新了影院体验。
- [Oregon AG Drops Motion to Delay Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/oregon-paramount-warner-bros-merger-drops-delay-1236807068/) 俄勒冈州撤回对这笔1110亿美元合并的延迟请求，交易或在7月22日左右收官，但加州等多州调查仍存在变量。
- [Jack White Offers Opening Slot to ‘Satanic’ Band Twin Temple](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jack-white-satanic-band-twin-temple-charley-crockett-1236807060/) 一场围绕“撒旦摇滚”的站队：乡村歌手Charley Crockett踢掉Twin Temple，而Jack White反向递橄榄枝，音乐圈文化战争再添注脚。
收束：AI监管、并购审查与音乐圈价值观冲突将在未来数周持续发酵，行业内部撕裂明显。
欧美.en:
The Hollywood and US entertainment landscape saw a day of mourning for three influential figures, while corporate maneuvering and AI controversies dominated headlines. The passing of veterans in production design, Disney innovation, and comedy marks the end of an era, while the accelerating Paramount-WBD merger and Meta's AI retreat signal structural shifts.

- Barbara Ling, Oscar-winning production designer for *Once Upon a Time in Hollywood*, died at 73 ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/barbara-ling-dead-once-upon-time-hollywood-production-designer-1236644433/)).
- Don Iwerks, Disney camera pioneer and co-founder of Iwerks Entertainment, died at 96; he was a Disney Legend and received the Gordon E. Sawyer Award ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/don-iwerks-dead-disney-exec-1236979775/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/don-iwerks-dead-disney-camera-legend-1236644425/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/artisans/news/donald-iwerks-dead-disney-camera-technician-iwerks-entertainment-1236807071/)).
- Peter Van Norden, actor in *Police Academy 2* and *The Naked Gun 2½*, died at 75 ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/peter-van-norden-dead-1236979743/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/peter-van-norden-dead-police-academy-naked-gun-actor-1236644400/)).
- Oregon Attorney General dropped a motion to delay the Paramount-WBD merger; the deal could close July 22, though other states investigate ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-oregon-attorney-general-motion-1236979773/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/oregon-paramount-warner-bros-merger-drops-delay-1236807068/)).
- Meta disabled its Muse AI image generator after CAA and SAG-AFTRA backlash, admitting they "missed the mark" ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/meta-disables-new-ai-image-generator-zuckerberg-1236979706/)).
- Christopher Nolan praised Gen Z for rejecting AI, calling it "hitting at exactly the wrong time" ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/christopher-nolan-praises-gen-z-utterly-rejecting-ai-1236979769/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/christopher-nolan-young-audiences-reject-ai-slop-1236644273/)).

These events signal a volatile period where legacy talent fades, corporate consolidation accelerates, and the industry draws a line on generative AI.

日韩.zh:
K-pop暑期档竞争提前升温，韩剧收视黑马出现波动。TXT成员然竣凭借第二张solo迷你专辑《NO LABELS: PART 02》发行首日便创下2026年韩国solo歌手最高首日销量纪录，彰显其在全球市场的号召力[TXTYeonjun Achieves Highest 1st-Day Sales](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853805wpp/txts-yeonjun-achieves-highest-1st-day-sales-of-any-korean-soloist-in-2026-with-no-labels-part-02)。Starship旗下女团KiiiKiii确认将于8月中旬回归，距上一张《Delulu Pack》约7个月，策略上紧跟夏季市场。
- [“Agent Kim Reactivated” Ratings Dip For 1st Time Since Premiere](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853808wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ratings-dip-for-1st-time-since-premiere) 这部由苏志燮主演的复仇动作剧收视率首次下跌，但仍以20%+的收视稳居年度榜首——后续能否守住基本盘值得关注。
- [SM Entertainment Reveals Accounts Already Facing Legal Action Over Malicious Posts](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853720wpp/sm-entertainment-reveals-accounts-already-facing-legal-action-over-malicious-posts) SM加大法律追诉力度，释放保护旗下艺人（如aespa、NCT等）的强烈信号。
- [Ex-SMAP Manager Michi Iijima is HYBE Japan's New J-pop Producer](https://news.google.) 前SMAP经纪人饭岛三智出任HYBE日本J-pop制作人，标志K-pop巨头加速本土化深耕。
收束：日韩市场呈现“老将抢眼、新团蓄力”格局，综艺与法律维权并行，行业规范意识上升。
日韩.en:
K-pop continues to break records with TXT's Yeonjun achieving the highest first-day sales of any Korean soloist in 2026, while KiiiKiii gears up for an August comeback. Korean drama 'Agent Kim Reactivated' remains the year's highest-rated despite a slight dip, and SM Entertainment intensifies legal action against malicious online comments. In Japan, HYBE hires former SMAP manager Michi Iijima as its new J-pop producer, signaling ambitions to expand in the Japanese market.

- TXT's Yeonjun set a new first-day sales record for Korean soloists in 2026 with "NO LABELS: PART 02" ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853805wpp/txts-yeonjun-achieves-highest-1st-day-sales-of-any-korean-soloist-in-2026-with-no-labels-part-02)).
- KiiiKiii confirmed a mid-August comeback, their first in seven months since 'Delulu Pack' ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853815wpp/kiiikiii-confirms-plans-for-august-comeback)).
- 'Agent Kim Reactivated' ratings dipped for the first time but still holds the highest viewership of any 2026 drama ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853808wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-ratings-dip-for-1st-time-since-premiere)).
- SM Entertainment revealed accounts already facing legal action for malicious posts, reaffirming artist protection ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853720wpp/sm-entertainment-reveals-accounts-already-facing-legal-action-over-malicious-posts)).
- Ex-SMAP manager Michi Iijima appointed as HYBE Japan's new J-pop producer, a major move in the Japanese market ([Outlook Respawn via Google News](https://news.google.)).

With Yeonjun's solo dominance and HYBE's Japan move, the K-pop/J-pop crossover is intensifying; watch for August comebacks and further legal crackdowns.
